AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS-aligned VPC flow logging remediation solution for AWS Systems Manager
  Automation. Creates an encrypted CloudWatch Logs group with a long compliance
  retention period, a VPC flow logs role used for log delivery and flow log
  resource management, a dedicated SSM Automation execution role, a direct
  Python-based runbook that enables REJECT-traffic flow logs on a VPC, and an
  approval-gated runbook whose executions must satisfy a formal aws:approve
  gate (approver of record: the template-created ChangeApproverUser,
  notifications on the CMK-encrypted topic) before the direct remediation
  runbook runs.

Resources:

  FlowLogEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Encrypts the VPC flow log CloudWatch Logs group for compliance.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/*'

  ChangeApprovalEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer managed key encrypting the change approval notification SNS
        topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowSsmServiceEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 3653
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogEncryptionKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Assumed by VPC Flow Logs to deliver flow log data to the compliance
        CloudWatch Logs group, and assumable by the automation to create and
        manage VPC flow log resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowAccountPrincipalsGrantedAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDeliveryAndManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogsToComplianceLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: CreateMissingFlowLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Assumed by Systems Manager Automation to execute the VPC flow log
        runbooks and their approval-gated remediation steps.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogAutomationExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeVpcFlowLogsRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Sid: RunAutomationAndApprovalGateSteps
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocumentParameters
                  - ssm:ListDocumentVersions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogsFromAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PublishChangeApprovalNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
              - Sid: EncryptChangeApprovalNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalEncryptionKey.Arn

  ChangeApproverUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-change-approver'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ChangeManagerApprovalOfRecord
        - Key: ComplianceControl
          Value: CIS-VPC-Flow-Logging
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChangeRequestApprovalActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SubmitApprovalDecisions
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
              - Sid: LocatePendingChangeRequests
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'

  ChangeApprovalTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-change-approvals'
      DisplayName: VPC Flow Log Approvals
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalEncryptionKey.Arn

  ChangeApprovalTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmToPublishApprovals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  DirectRemediationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables REJECT-traffic VPC flow logs on the supplied VPC. The runbook
          assumes the shared VPC flow logs role and invokes the EC2
          CreateFlowLogs API from Python, delivering flow log data to the
          compliance CloudWatch Logs group. Existing active flow logs that
          already capture rejected traffic are reported and left unchanged.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which REJECT-traffic flow logs will be enabled.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}$'
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role shared by VPC Flow Logs and the automation.
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: The CloudWatch Logs group that receives the flow log data.
            default: !Ref FlowLogGroup
        mainSteps:
          - name: VerifyVpcExists
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
          - name: EnableRejectFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: enable_reject_flow_logs
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                Region: !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
                FlowLogsRoleArn: '{{ FlowLogsRoleArn }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
              Script: |
                import boto3


                def assume_flow_logs_role(role_arn, region):
                    """Assume the shared VPC flow logs role and return an EC2 client."""
                    sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                    credentials = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=role_arn,
                        RoleSessionName='EnableVpcFlowLogs'
                    )['Credentials']
                    return boto3.client(
                        'ec2',
                        region_name=region,
                        aws_access_key_id=credentials['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=credentials['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=credentials['SessionToken']
                    )


                def enable_reject_flow_logs(events, context):
                    """Enable REJECT-traffic VPC flow logs on a single VPC (idempotent)."""
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    region = events['Region']
                    role_arn = events['FlowLogsRoleArn']
                    log_group_name = events['LogGroupName']

                    ec2 = assume_flow_logs_role(role_arn, region)

                    vpcs = ec2.describe_vpcs(VpcIds=[vpc_id]).get('Vpcs', [])
                    if not vpcs:
                        raise ValueError(f'VPC {vpc_id} does not exist in region {region}.')

                    existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'resource-type', 'Values': ['VPC']}
                        ]
                    ).get('FlowLogs', [])

                    for flow_log in existing:
                        if (
                            flow_log.get('FlowLogStatus') == 'ACTIVE'
                            and flow_log.get('TrafficType') in ('REJECT', 'ALL')
                        ):
                            return {
                                'FlowLogId': flow_log['FlowLogId'],
                                'Status': 'ALREADY_ENABLED',
                                'TrafficType': flow_log.get('TrafficType'),
                                'VpcId': vpc_id
                            }

                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn,
                        MaxAggregationInterval=60,
                        TagSpecifications=[
                            {
                                'ResourceType': 'vpc-flow-log',
                                'Tags': [
                                    {'Key': 'ManagedBy', 'Value': 'SSM-Automation'},
                                    {'Key': 'ComplianceControl', 'Value': 'CIS-VPC-Flow-Logging'}
                                ]
                            }
                        ]
                    )

                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful') or []
                    if unsuccessful:
                        messages = [
                            item.get('Error', {}).get('Message', 'Unknown error')
                            for item in unsuccessful
                        ]
                        raise RuntimeError(f'CreateFlowLogs failed: {"; ".join(messages)}')

                    flow_logs = response.get('FlowLogs', [])
                    if not flow_logs:
                        raise RuntimeError('CreateFlowLogs did not return a flow log identifier.')

                    return {
                        'FlowLogId': flow_logs[0]['FlowLogId'],
                        'Status': 'CREATED',
                        'TrafficType': 'REJECT',
                        'VpcId': vpc_id
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogId
                Selector: '$.FlowLogId'
              - Name: Status
                Selector: '$.Status'
              - Name: TrafficType
                Selector: '$.TrafficType'
          - name: WaitForFlowLogActive
            action: aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeFlowLogs
              FlowLogIds:
                - '{{ EnableRejectFlowLogs.FlowLogId }}'
              PropertySelector: '$.FlowLogs[0].FlowLogStatus'
              DesiredValues:
                - ACTIVE
        outputs:
          - EnableRejectFlowLogs.FlowLogId
          - EnableRejectFlowLogs.Status
          - EnableRejectFlowLogs.TrafficType

  ChangeManagedRemediationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs-change-request'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Approval-gated runbook that routes the VPC flow log remediation
          through a formal change approval before the fix is applied. Every
          execution stops at the aws:approve gate until at least
          MinRequiredApprovals approvals are received from the Approvers
          supplied at execution time (the template-created approver user
          ChangeApproverUser is the designated approver of record), and only
          then does the EnableVpcFlowLogs step start the direct remediation
          runbook (named by the RunbookName parameter) as a child automation
          and wait for it to complete successfully, so every real-world use of
          the flow log fix goes through change approval. Approval
          notifications are published to the CMK-encrypted SNS topic named by
          ApproverSnsTopicArn.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC on which REJECT-traffic flow logs will be enabled.
          Approvers:
            type: StringList
            description: >-
              The IAM principals (user or role ARNs) required to approve this
              execution before remediation proceeds.
          ApproverSnsTopicArn:
            type: String
            description: The SNS topic that receives change approval notifications.
            default: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
          RunbookName:
            type: String
            description: The direct remediation runbook started after approval.
            default: !Ref DirectRemediationDocument
        mainSteps:
          - name: Approval
            action: aws:approve
            timeoutSeconds: 604800
            inputs:
              Message: 'Please approve enabling REJECT-traffic VPC flow logs on {{ VpcId }}.'
              MinRequiredApprovals: 1
              Approvers: '{{ Approvers }}'
              NotificationArn: '{{ ApproverSnsTopicArn }}'
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: StartAutomationExecution
              DocumentName: '{{ RunbookName }}'
              Parameters:
                VpcId:
                  - '{{ VpcId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: AutomationExecutionId
                Selector: '$.AutomationExecutionId'
          - name: WaitForChildCompletion
            action: aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty
            timeoutSeconds: 1800
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetAutomationExecution
              AutomationExecutionId: '{{ EnableVpcFlowLogs.AutomationExecutionId }}'
              PropertySelector: '$.AutomationExecution.AutomationExecutionStatus'
              DesiredValues:
                - Success
        outputs:
          - EnableVpcFlowLogs.AutomationExecutionId

Outputs:

    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs group that receives VPC flow log data.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
  FlowLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted compliance CloudWatch Logs group.

  FlowLogsRoleArn:
    Description: >-

    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

  ChangeApproverUserArn:
    Description: IAM user that serves as the approver of record for VPC flow log change requests.
    Value: !GetAtt ChangeApproverUser.Arn
  DirectRunbookName:
    Description: Automation runbook that directly enables REJECT-traffic flow logs on a VPC.
    Value: !Ref DirectRemediationDocument
  ApprovalGatedRunbookName:
    Description: >-
      Approval-gated Automation runbook whose aws:approve gate must be

    Value: !Ref ChangeManagedRemediationDocument
  ChangeApprovalTopicArn:
    Description: SNS topic that receives change approval notifications.
    Value: !Ref ChangeApprovalTopic
  ChangeApprovalEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: Customer managed KMS key encrypting the change approval SNS topic.
    Value: !GetAtt ChangeApprovalEncryptionKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless WebSocket API (Amazon API Gateway) whose $default route asynchronously
  starts a standard AWS Step Functions state machine, passing the incoming message
  and the connection ID as the execution input. After a five second wait, the state
  machine sends a response back to the connected WebSocket client using the API
  Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Deployment stage name for the WebSocket API.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Stage name can contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: websocket-step-functions-api
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'
      Description: WebSocket API that starts Step Functions executions from the $default route.

  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows API Gateway to start executions of the Step Functions state machine on behalf of WebSocket clients.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayStartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'states:StartExecution'
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the state machine to invoke the WebSocket response function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineInvokeResponseFunction
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource: !GetAtt WebSocketResponseFunction.Arn

  WebSocketResponseFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the function that posts responses to connected WebSocket clients.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebSocketResponseFunctionPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'execute-api:Invoke'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'

  WebSocketResponseFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Posts a response to the connected WebSocket client using the API Gateway Management API.
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 15
      Role: !GetAtt WebSocketResponseFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          WEBSOCKET_ENDPOINT: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const { ApiGatewayManagementApiClient, PostToConnectionCommand } = require('@aws-sdk/client-apigatewaymanagementapi');

          const client = new ApiGatewayManagementApiClient({
            endpoint: process.env.WEBSOCKET_ENDPOINT
          });

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const originalMessage = typeof event.Message === 'string'
              ? event.Message
              : JSON.stringify(event.Message ?? null);

            const data = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
              type: 'response',
              connectionId: event.ConnectionId,
              originalMessage: originalMessage,
              status: 'Processed by the Step Functions state machine after a 5 second wait'
            }), 'utf8');

            try {
              await client.send(new PostToConnectionCommand({
                ConnectionId: event.ConnectionId,
                Data: data
              }));
              return { connectionId: event.ConnectionId, delivered: true };
            } catch (error) {
              if (error.name === 'GoneException' || error.name === 'ForbiddenException') {
                console.warn(`Connection ${event.ConnectionId} is no longer available (${error.name}).`);
                return { connectionId: event.ConnectionId, delivered: false, reason: error.name };
              }
              throw error;
            }
          };

  WebSocketResponseFunctionLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${WebSocketResponseFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Waits five seconds and then sends a response back to the connected WebSocket client using the API Gateway Management API.",
            "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
            "States": {
              "WaitFiveSeconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "SendResponseToWebSocketClient"
              },
              "SendResponseToWebSocketClient": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${ResponseFunctionArn}",
                "Parameters": {
                  "ConnectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                  "Message.$": "$.message"
                },
                "Retry": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"],
                    "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                    "MaxAttempts": 2,
                    "BackoffRate": 2.0
                  }
                ],
                "ResultPath": null,
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - ResponseFunctionArn: !GetAtt WebSocketResponseFunction.Arn

  WebSocketIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Starts a Step Functions execution for every message received on the $default route.
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TimeoutInMillis: 10000
      RequestTemplates:
        '$default': !Sub |
          #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
          #if($inputRoot.message)
            #set($messageText = $util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.message).replaceAll("\\'","'"))
          #else
            #set($messageText = '')
          #end
          {
            "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
            "input": "{\"connectionId\": \"$context.connectionId\", \"message\": \"$messageText\"}"
          }

  WebSocketDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: '$default'
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${WebSocketIntegration}'

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - WebSocketDefaultRoute
      - WebSocketIntegration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true
      Description: WebSocket API stage named by the StageName parameter.

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket endpoint clients connect to.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: The API Gateway WebSocket API identifier.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: The standard Step Functions state machine started by the $default route.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Hourly EventBridge schedule that invokes an Express Step Functions state machine
  which paginates AWS Organization accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED,
  describes each account, closes ACTIVE accounts via organizations:CloseAccount,
  re-tags them as ACKNOWLEDGED, retries throttling and eventual-consistency errors,
  and logs all execution data to a CloudWatch log group retained for 365 days.

Resources:
  ClosureWorkflowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the organization account closure Express state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationAccountClosureActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListOrganizationAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ReadOrganizationAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*"
              - Sid: CloseOrganizationAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*"
              - Sid: AcknowledgeClosureByTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Action: organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:TagKeys: organizations:account-closure
        - PolicyName: StateMachineExecutionLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageExecutionLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:GetResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: WriteExecutionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ClosureWorkflowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ClosureWorkflowLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ClosureWorkflowLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "Comment": "Hourly workflow: closes AWS Organization accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED when they are ACTIVE, then re-tags them as ACKNOWLEDGED. Includes throttling retries and eventual-consistency handling.",
          "StartAt": "ListAccountsPage1",
          "States": {
            "ListAccountsPage1": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
              "Parameters": {},
              "TimeoutSeconds": 30,
              "ResultPath": "$.listResult",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                    "TooManyRequestsException",
                    "ThrottlingException",
                    "States.Timeout"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                  "MaxAttempts": 4,
                  "MaxDelaySeconds": 20,
                  "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                    "Organizations.ServiceException",
                    "States.TaskFailed"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "MaxDelaySeconds": 30,
                  "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                  "ResultPath": "$.listError",
                  "Next": "ListAccountsFailed"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsPage"
            },
            "ProcessAccountsPage": {
              "Type": "Map",
              "ItemsPath": "$.listResult.Accounts",
              "MaxConcurrency": 10,
              "ResultPath": "$.pageOutcomes",
              "ItemProcessor": {
                "ProcessorConfig": {
                  "Mode": "INLINE"
                },
                "StartAt": "GetAccountTags",
                "States": {
                  "GetAccountTags": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "TimeoutSeconds": 30,
                    "ResultPath": "$.tagList",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "States.Timeout"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 20,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException",
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 30,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.tagError",
                        "Next": "SkipTagLookupFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "EvaluateClosureTags"
                  },
                  "EvaluateClosureTags": {
                    "Type": "Map",
                    "ItemsPath": "$.tagList.Tags",
                    "MaxConcurrency": 10,
                    "ResultPath": "$.tagChecks",
                    "ItemProcessor": {
                      "ProcessorConfig": {
                        "Mode": "INLINE"
                      },
                      "StartAt": "IsClosureTagKey",
                      "States": {
                        "IsClosureTagKey": {
                          "Type": "Choice",
                          "Choices": [
                            {
                              "Variable": "$.Key",
                              "StringEquals": "organizations:account-closure",
                              "Next": "IsRequestedValue"
                            }
                          ],
                          "Default": "TagNotRequested"
                        },
                        "IsRequestedValue": {
                          "Type": "Choice",
                          "Choices": [
                            {
                              "Variable": "$.Value",
                              "StringEquals": "REQUESTED",
                              "Next": "TagRequested"
                            }
                          ],
                          "Default": "TagNotRequested"
                        },
                        "TagRequested": {
                          "Type": "Pass",
                          "Result": "REQUESTED",
                          "End": true
                        },
                        "TagNotRequested": {
                          "Type": "Pass",
                          "Result": "NOT_REQUESTED",
                          "End": true
                        }
                      }
                    },
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.tagError",
                        "Next": "SkipTagLookupFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "ComputeRequestFlag"
                  },
                  "ComputeRequestFlag": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "requested.$": "States.ArrayContains($.tagChecks, 'REQUESTED')"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.requestFlag",
                    "Next": "IsRequestedAccount"
                  },
                  "IsRequestedAccount": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.requestFlag.requested",
                        "BooleanEquals": true,
                        "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "SkipNotRequested"
                  },
                  "DescribeAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "TimeoutSeconds": 30,
                    "ResultPath": "$.account",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "States.Timeout"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 20,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException",
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 30,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.describeError",
                        "Next": "SkipDescribeFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "IsAccountActive"
                  },
                  "IsAccountActive": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.account.Account.Status",
                        "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                        "Next": "CloseAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "SkipNotActive"
                  },
                  "CloseAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "TimeoutSeconds": 30,
                    "ResultPath": "$.closeResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "States.Timeout"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 20,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException",
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 30,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.closeError",
                        "Next": "CloseFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "TagAccountAcknowledged"
                  },
                  "TagAccountAcknowledged": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Tags": [
                        {
                          "Key": "organizations:account-closure",
                          "Value": "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "TimeoutSeconds": 30,
                    "ResultPath": "$.ackTagResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "TooManyRequestsException",
                          "ThrottlingException",
                          "States.Timeout"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 4,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 20,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.AccountNotFoundException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException",
                          "States.TaskFailed"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "MaxDelaySeconds": 30,
                        "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                        "ResultPath": "$.ackTagError",
                        "Next": "AcknowledgedTagFailed"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "CloseAndAcknowledgeSucceeded"
                  },
                  "CloseAndAcknowledgeSucceeded": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "outcome": "CLOSED_AND_ACKNOWLEDGED"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "CloseFailed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "outcome": "CLOSE_FAILED",
                      "error.$": "$.closeError.Error",
                      "cause.$": "$.closeError.Cause"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "AcknowledgedTagFailed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "outcome": "CLOSED_TAG_FAILED",
                      "error.$": "$.ackTagError.Error",
                      "cause.$": "$.ackTagError.Cause"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "SkipNotRequested": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "outcome": "SKIPPED_NOT_REQUESTED"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "SkipNotActive": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "status.$": "$.account.Account.Status",
                      "outcome": "SKIPPED_NOT_ACTIVE"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "SkipTagLookupFailed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "outcome": "SKIPPED_TAG_LOOKUP_FAILED",
                      "error.$": "$.tagError.Error",
                      "cause.$": "$.tagError.Cause"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "SkipDescribeFailed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "outcome": "SKIPPED_DESCRIBE_FAILED",
                      "error.$": "$.describeError.Error",
                      "cause.$": "$.describeError.Cause"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  }
                }
              },
              "Next": "HasMorePages"
            },
            "HasMorePages": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.listResult.NextToken",
                  "IsPresent": true,
                  "Next": "ListAccountsNextPage"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "WorkflowSucceeded"
            },
            "ListAccountsNextPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
              "Parameters": {
                "NextToken.$": "$.listResult.NextToken"
              },
              "TimeoutSeconds": 30,
              "ResultPath": "$.listResult",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                    "TooManyRequestsException",
                    "ThrottlingException",
                    "States.Timeout"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 1,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                  "MaxAttempts": 4,
                  "MaxDelaySeconds": 20,
                  "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                    "Organizations.ServiceException",
                    "States.TaskFailed"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "BackoffRate": 2.0,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "MaxDelaySeconds": 30,
                  "JitterStrategy": "FULL"
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                  "ResultPath": "$.listError",
                  "Next": "ListAccountsFailed"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountsPage"
            },
            "WorkflowSucceeded": {
              "Type": "Succeed"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline building a daily Amazon Linux 2023
  (ARM64) AMI, pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk, with a 50 GB root EBS
  volume. The build network is fully private: no public IPs, connectivity via
  in-template VPC endpoints only (SSM, SSM Messages, EC2 Messages, CloudWatch
  Logs, ECR API, and ECR DKR interfaces provisioned through a Lambda-backed
  custom resource, plus an S3 gateway endpoint). Images are scanned via Amazon
  Inspector (scan outputs delivered to the in-template ECR repository with
  ScanOnPush enabled), distributed to the current region with launch
  permissions shared to an AWS Organization and two deployment accounts, and
  automatically deleted after 6 months by a lifecycle policy. The parent image
  is resolved from the ParentImageAmiId SSM parameter type (AWS-published
  AL2023 ARM64 AMI by default); see that parameter's description for restoring
  CIS Level 1 hardening.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-0000000000'
    Description: >-
      AWS Organization ID (e.g. o-1234567890) to grant AMI launch permissions
      to. The template must be deployed in the AWS Organizations management
      account. The default is a placeholder consistent with the dummy
      dev/prod account defaults and must be overridden for real deployments.
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organization ID, e.g. o-1234567890.

  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dummy dev environment AWS account ID that is granted AMI launch permissions.
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dummy prod environment AWS account ID that is granted AMI launch permissions.
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

  ParentImageAmiId:
    Type: 'AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>'
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64
    Description: >-
      Resolved at deploy time by CloudFormation from the AWS-published Amazon
      Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI public parameter (region-aware, latest default
      kernel), so the stack deploys with zero overrides and no hardcoded AMI
      literal. Override at deployment with the AMI ID of the CIS-hardened
      marketplace image
      'cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
      once a subscription exists to restore CIS Level 1 hardening.

          import boto3
          import time

          import cfnresponse

          HEADROOM_S = 15


          def retryable(e):
              r = getattr(e, 'response', None)
              return isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('Error', {}).get(
                  'Code', '') in (
                  'Throttling', 'ThrottlingException',
                  'RequestLimitExceeded', 'InternalError',
                  'ServiceUnavailable', 'SlowDown')


          def retry(context, deadline, fn, **kw):
              while True:
                  try:
                      return fn(**kw)
                  except Exception as e:
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def resolve_prefix_list_id(context, deadline, name):
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              prefix_list_id = None
              paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_prefix_lists')
              for page in paginator.paginate(
                      Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name',
                                'Values': [name]}]):
                  for pl in page.get('PrefixLists', []):
                      prefix_list_id = pl['PrefixListId']
                      break
                  if prefix_list_id:
                      break
              if not prefix_list_id:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      'Managed prefix list not found: %s' % name)
              return prefix_list_id


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  deadline = time.time() + max(
                      context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() / 1000.0
                      - HEADROOM_S, 1)
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  if request_type in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      name = event['ResourceProperties']['PrefixListName']
                      prefix_list_id = resolve_prefix_list_id(
                          context, deadline, name)
                      physical_id = prefix_list_id
                      if request_type == 'Update':
                          physical_id = event['PhysicalResourceId']
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'PrefixListId': prefix_list_id}, physical_id)
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {},
                          event.get('PhysicalResourceId',
                                    'prefix-list-resolver-deleted'))
              except Exception as e:
                  try:
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {},
                          event.get('PhysicalResourceId',
                                    'prefix-list-resolver'),
                          reason=str(e))
                  except Exception:
                      pass
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: AWS CloudFormation

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:

      Runtime: python3.12

      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt InterfaceEndpointsCustomResourceRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import time

          import cfnresponse

          HEADROOM_S = 15
          RETRYABLE = (
              'Throttling', 'ThrottlingException', 'RequestLimitExceeded',
              'InternalError', 'ServiceUnavailable', 'SlowDown',
              'InvalidGroup.NotFound', 'InvalidSubnetId.NotFound')


          def to_bool(value, default=True):
              if value is None:
                  return default
              if isinstance(value, bool):
                  return value
              if isinstance(value, str):
                  return value.strip().lower() in ('true', '1', 'yes')
              return bool(value)


          def retryable(e):
              code = ''
              r = getattr(e, 'response', None)
              if isinstance(r, dict):
                  code = r.get('Error', {}).get('Code', '')
              return code in RETRYABLE


          def retry(context, deadline, fn, **kw):
              while True:
                  try:
                      return fn(**kw)
                  except Exception as e:
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def create_endpoint(ec2, context, deadline, props, service):
              resp = retry(
                  context, deadline, ec2.create_vpc_endpoint,
                  VpcId=props['VpcId'],
                  ServiceName=service,
                  VpcEndpointType='Interface',
                  SubnetIds=props['SubnetIds'],
                  SecurityGroupIds=props['SecurityGroupIds'],
                  PrivateDnsEnabled=to_bool(
                      props.get('PrivateDnsEnabled'), True))
              return resp['VpcEndpoint']['VpcEndpointId']


          def delete_endpoint(ec2, context, deadline, endpoint_id):
              while True:
                  try:
                      ec2.delete_vpc_endpoint(VpcEndpointId=endpoint_id)
                      return
                  except ec2.exceptions.ClientError as e:
                      code = e.response.get('Error', {}).get('Code', '')
                      if code == 'InvalidVpcEndpointId.NotFound':
                          return
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def owned_by_service(ec2, props):
              found = {}
              paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_vpc_endpoints')
              for page in paginator.paginate(
                      Filters=[
                          {'Name': 'vpc-id',
                           'Values': [props['VpcId']]},
                          {'Name': 'service-name',
                           'Values': props['Services']}]):
                  for ep in page.get('VpcEndpoints', []):
                      found[ep['ServiceName']] = ep['VpcEndpointId']
              return found


          def old_owned(ec2, event, props):
              old_ids = [i for i in
                         (event.get('PhysicalResourceId') or '').split(',')
                         if i.startswith('vpce-')]
              if not old_ids:
                  return owned_by_service(ec2, props)
              try:
                  resp = ec2.describe_vpc_endpoints(
                      VpcEndpointIds=old_ids)
                  return {ep['ServiceName']: ep['VpcEndpointId']
                          for ep in resp.get('VpcEndpoints', [])}
              except ec2.exceptions.ClientError:
                  return owned_by_service(ec2, props)


          def respond(event, context, mapping, order, physical_id):
              ids = [mapping[s] for s in order]
              data = {'EndpointIds': ','.join(ids)}
              data.update(mapping)
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data,
                               physical_id)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  deadline = time.time() + max(
                      context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() / 1000.0
                      - HEADROOM_S, 1)
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                  props = event.get('ResourceProperties') or {}
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      mapping = {}
                      for svc in props['Services']:
                          mapping[svc] = create_endpoint(
                              ec2, context, deadline, props, svc)
                      respond(event, context, mapping, props['Services'],
                              ','.join(mapping[s]
                                       for s in props['Services']))
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      existing = old_owned(ec2, event, props)
                      mapping = {}
                      for svc in props['Services']:
                          if svc in existing:
                              mapping[svc] = existing[svc]
                          else:
                              mapping[svc] = create_endpoint(
                                  ec2, context, deadline, props, svc)
                      for svc, eid in existing.items():
                          if svc not in props['Services']:
                              delete_endpoint(ec2, context, deadline, eid)
                      respond(event, context, mapping, props['Services'],
                              event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
                              or ','.join(mapping[s]
                                          for s in props['Services']))
                  else:
                      doomed = set()
                      try:
                          doomed.update(
                              owned_by_service(ec2, props).values())
                      except Exception:
                          pass
                      if not doomed:
                          for i in (
                                  event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
                                  or '').split(','):
                              if i.startswith('vpce-'):
                                  doomed.add(i)
                      for eid in doomed:
                          delete_endpoint(ec2, context, deadline, eid)
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {},
                          event.get('PhysicalResourceId',
                                    'interface-endpoints-deleted'))
              except Exception as e:
                  try:
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {},
                          event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'ie-cr'),
                          reason=str(e))
                  except Exception:
                      pass

  InstanceProfileCustomResourceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-profile-cfn'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt InstanceProfileCustomResourceRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import time

          import cfnresponse

          SUF = '-instance-profile'
          HEADROOM_S = 15


          def retryable(e):
              r = getattr(e, 'response', None)
              return isinstance(r, dict) and r.get('Error', {}).get(
                  'Code', '') in (
                  'Throttling', 'ThrottlingException',
                  'RequestLimitExceeded', 'InternalError',
                  'ServiceUnavailable', 'SlowDown')


          def retry(context, deadline, fn, **kw):
              while True:
                  try:
                      return fn(**kw)
                  except Exception as e:
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def get_profile(iam, context, deadline, name):
              return retry(context, deadline, iam.get_instance_profile,
                           InstanceProfileName=name)


          def roles_in(iam, context, deadline, name):
              p = get_profile(iam, context, deadline, name)
              return [r['RoleName'] for r in
                      p['InstanceProfile'].get('Roles', [])]


          def wait_visible(iam, context, deadline, name):
              while True:
                  try:
                      get_profile(iam, context, deadline, name)
                      return
                  except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                      if time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise RuntimeError(
                              'Instance profile %s not visible in IAM '
                              'before the execution budget expired'
                              % name)
                      time.sleep(2)


          def detach(iam, context, deadline, name, role):
              while True:
                  try:
                      iam.remove_role_from_instance_profile(
                          InstanceProfileName=name, RoleName=role)
                      return
                  except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                      return
                  except Exception as e:
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def attach(iam, context, deadline, name, role):
              while True:
                  try:
                      iam.add_role_to_instance_profile(
                          InstanceProfileName=name, RoleName=role)
                      return
                  except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                      if time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise RuntimeError(
                              'Role %s not visible in IAM before the '
                              'execution budget expired' % role)
                      time.sleep(2)
                  except Exception as e:
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def ensure_state(iam, context, deadline, name, role):
              try:
                  iam.create_instance_profile(
                      InstanceProfileName=name)
              except iam.exceptions.EntityAlreadyExistsException:
                  pass
              wait_visible(iam, context, deadline, name)
              current = roles_in(iam, context, deadline, name)
              for r in current:
                  if r != role:
                      detach(iam, context, deadline, name, r)
              if role not in current:
                  attach(iam, context, deadline, name, role)


          def delete_profile(iam, context, deadline, name):
              try:
                  p = get_profile(iam, context, deadline, name)
              except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                  return
              for r in p['InstanceProfile'].get('Roles', []):
                  detach(iam, context, deadline, name, r['RoleName'])
              while True:
                  try:
                      iam.delete_instance_profile(
                          InstanceProfileName=name)
                      return
                  except iam.exceptions.NoSuchEntityException:
                      return
                  except Exception as e:
                      if not retryable(e) or time.time() >= deadline:
                          raise
                      time.sleep(2)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  deadline = time.time() + max(
                      context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() / 1000.0
                      - HEADROOM_S, 1)
                  iam = boto3.client('iam')
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  base = props.get('ProfileNameBase', 'imagebuilder')
                  name = (base if len(base) + len(SUF) <= 128
                          else base[:128 - len(SUF)]) + SUF
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      prev = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
                      if (event['RequestType'] == 'Update' and prev
                              and prev != name and SUF in prev):
                          delete_profile(iam, context, deadline, prev)
                      ensure_state(iam, context, deadline, name,
                                   props['RoleName'])
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {'InstanceProfileName': name}, name)
                  else:
                      pid = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
                      if pid and SUF in pid:
                          delete_profile(iam, context, deadline, pid)
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {},
                          pid or 'instance-profile-deleted')
              except Exception as e:
                  try:
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {},
                          event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'ip-cr'),
                          reason=str(e))
                  except Exception:
                      pass
      Tags:
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: AWS CloudFormation

  ElasticBeanstalkPreConfigurationComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eb-preconfig'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: >-
        Pre-configures the Amazon Linux 2023 ARM base image for Elastic
        Beanstalk compatibility: cloud-init user-data handling, EB application
        directory layout, webapp service account, platform dependencies, log
        collection agent and SSM agent.
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkPreConfiguration
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSystemPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf -y update
              - name: InstallElasticBeanstalkPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf -y install ruby jq nginx amazon-cloudwatch-agent chrony cloud-init
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent chronyd amazon-cloudwatch-agent
              - name: CreateElasticBeanstalkDirectoryLayout
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      mkdir -p /var/app/current /var/app/ondeck /var/app/staging /var/app/support /var/log/eb-engine
                      chmod 0755 /var/app /var/app/current /var/app/ondeck /var/app/staging /var/app/support
              - name: CreateWebappServiceAccount
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      id webapp >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --system --home-dir /var/app --shell /sbin/nologin webapp
                      chown -R webapp:webapp /var/app
              - name: ConfigureCloudInitForElasticBeanstalk
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      printf 'preserve_hostname: false\n' > /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/90-elasticbeanstalk-hostname.cfg
                      printf 'ssh_pwauth: false\n' > /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/90-elasticbeanstalk-ssh-auth.cfg
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyElasticBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      rpm -q ruby jq nginx amazon-cloudwatch-agent cloud-init
                      systemctl is-enabled amazon-ssm-agent chronyd
                      test -d /var/app/current
                      id webapp
      Tags:
        ManagedBy: AWS CloudFormation
