final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Regional API Gateway with a
  Cognito-protected POST /mcp endpoint, CORS support via OPTIONS, and a public health
  check on the root path. Lambda runs Python 3.12 with a placeholder handler.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment stage used as the API Gateway stage name.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito app client.

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailVerificationSubject: Verify your email for the Maths MCP server
      EmailVerificationMessage: !Sub >-
        Welcome to ${UserPoolName}. Your verification code is {####}.
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  MathsMcpLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMcpLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-lambda'
      Description: Placeholder handler for the Maths MCP server (to be updated later).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MathsMcpLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DEPLOYMENT_STAGE: !Ref DeploymentStage
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """Placeholder handler for the Maths MCP server."""
              method = event.get("httpMethod", "")
              path = event.get("path", "")

              if method == "GET" and path == "/":
                  status_code = 200
                  body = {"status": "healthy", "service": "maths-mcp-server"}
              elif method == "POST" and path == "/mcp":
                  status_code = 200
                  body = {
                      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                      "id": None,
                      "result": "Maths MCP server placeholder response",
                  }
              else:
                  status_code = 404
                  body = {"message": "Not Found"}

              return {
                  "statusCode": status_code,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET,POST,OPTIONS",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      Description: Regional REST API for the Maths MCP server.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  McpCognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-cognito-authorizer'
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  RootHealthCheckMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub >-
          arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref McpCognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub >-
          arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST,GET'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootHealthCheckMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      Description: Deployment stage for the Maths MCP server API.

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpLambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'

Outputs:
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the deployed API stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  HealthCheckUrl:
    Description: Public health check endpoint (no authentication required).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/'
  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint (requires a Cognito access token in the Authorization header).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the Maths MCP Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpLambdaFunction

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Amazon SageMaker notebook instance "rapidsai" for RAPIDS AI development.
  Creates the SageMaker execution IAM role (AmazonSageMakerFullAccess), a
  lifecycle configuration that installs a RAPIDS AI conda environment and
  registers the RAPIDS Jupyter kernel on notebook creation and start, and an
  ml.t3.medium notebook instance with 50 GB of storage whose default code
  repository is https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks.

Resources:
  RapidsAiSageMakerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-sagemaker-execution-role

  RapidsAiLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e

            # SageMaker lifecycle configuration scripts time out after 5
            # minutes, so the multi-GB RAPIDS conda installation is launched
            # in the background. Progress is logged to
            # /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log on the notebook volume.

            cat > /home/ec2-user/install-rapids.sh <<'RAPIDS_INSTALLER'
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            set -x

            # Prevent concurrent installer runs
            exec 9>/home/ec2-user/rapids-install.lock
            flock -n 9 || exit 0

            export HOME=/home/ec2-user
            export PATH=/home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh

            # Install the RAPIDS AI conda environment (skipped if it exists)
            if ! conda env list | grep -qE '^rapids[[:space:]]'; then
              conda create -y -n rapids \
                -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                python=3.11 ipykernel rapids=24.12 cuda-version=12.5
            fi

            conda activate rapids

            # Register the RAPIDS environment as a Jupyter kernel for ec2-user
            python -m ipykernel install --user \
              --name rapids \
              --display-name 'RAPIDS (Python 3)' \
              --force

            echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) RAPIDS conda environment and Jupyter kernel ready" >> /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log
            RAPIDS_INSTALLER

            chown ec2-user:ec2-user /home/ec2-user/install-rapids.sh
            chmod 755 /home/ec2-user/install-rapids.sh
            touch /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log
            chown ec2-user:ec2-user /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log

            # Launch the installer in the background as ec2-user
            nohup sudo -u ec2-user -i /home/ec2-user/install-rapids.sh \
              >> /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log 2>&1 &

            echo "RAPIDS installation started in the background; monitor /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log"
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e

            # Runs on every notebook instance start. Re-registers the RAPIDS
            # Jupyter kernel; if the background install from OnCreate has not
            # completed yet, it is relaunched so the environment converges on
            # this start.

            touch /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log
            chown ec2-user:ec2-user /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log

            STATUS_FILE=/tmp/rapids-kernel-status
            rm -f "$STATUS_FILE"

            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF' || true
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if conda env list | grep -qE '^rapids[[:space:]]' \
              && conda activate rapids \
              && python -m ipykernel install --user \
                   --name rapids \
                   --display-name 'RAPIDS (Python 3)' \
                   --force \
                   >> /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log 2>&1
            then
              echo ready > /tmp/rapids-kernel-status
            else
              echo pending > /tmp/rapids-kernel-status
            fi
            EOF

            if [ "$(cat "$STATUS_FILE" 2>/dev/null)" = "ready" ]; then
              echo "RAPIDS Jupyter kernel registered."
            elif [ -f /home/ec2-user/install-rapids.sh ]; then
              nohup sudo -u ec2-user -i /home/ec2-user/install-rapids.sh \
                >> /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log 2>&1 &
              echo "RAPIDS environment installation is still in progress; the kernel will be registered when it completes (log: /home/ec2-user/rapids-install.log)."
            fi

  RapidsAiNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      RoleArn: !GetAtt RapidsAiSageMakerRole.Arn
      InstanceType: "ml.t3.medium"
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      LifecycleConfigName: !GetAtt RapidsAiLifecycleConfig.NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName
      DefaultCodeRepository: "https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Ref RapidsAiNotebookInstance
  NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName:
    Description: Name of the notebook instance lifecycle configuration
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsAiLifecycleConfig.NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName
  SageMakerExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM execution role used by the notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsAiSageMakerRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with private Cloud Map DNS (SRV) service
  discovery. Builds its own VPC (internet gateway, NAT gateway, one public subnet,
  two private subnets across separate AZs), an ECS cluster, container security group,
  task execution role, CloudWatch log group, and CPU-based application auto scaling
  (2 to 10 tasks) driven by two CloudWatch alarms. Includes VPC endpoints (ECR, logs,
  S3, ECS agent/telemetry) to accelerate and harden private-subnet task traffic; the
  container security group declares ingress only and relies on the AWS default
  allow-all egress rule so tasks can reach the NAT gateway (ECR Public pulls),
  S3 gateway endpoint (image layers), and the ECS control plane.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application
        Parameters:
          - ServiceName
          - ContainerImage
          - ContainerPort
          - TaskCpu
          - TaskMemory
          - DesiredCount
      - Label:
          default: Environment
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
          - VpcCidr
      - Label:
          default: Security
        Parameters:
          - CustomTaskRoleArn

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for naming and tagging (also the private DNS namespace label).
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9][-a-zA-Z0-9]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Environment name must be alphanumeric, may contain hyphens, and cannot start with a hyphen.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: web
    Description: Service name; becomes the Cloud Map service name registered in the private DNS namespace.
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Service name must start with a letter and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nginx:stable
    Description: Container image to deploy (default is nginx).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port the container listens on (default 80 for nginx).
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535

  TaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: Fargate task CPU units (256 = 0.25 vCPU). Must pair with a valid Fargate memory value.
    MinValue: 256
    MaxValue: 16384

  TaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB; must form a valid Fargate combination with TaskCpu (e.g. 256/512, 512/1024, 1024/2048).
    MinValue: 512
    MaxValue: 122880

  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Initial desired task count (auto scaling keeps the service between 2 and 10 tasks).
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10

  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN that the containers assume to access other AWS resources. Leave empty to create a default task role.
    AllowedPattern: '(^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_/-]+$)'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IAM role ARN.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created by this stack.
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

Conditions:
  UseCustomTaskRole: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
      - ''
  CreateDefaultTaskRole: !Equals
    - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
    - ''

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 0
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 6
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 1
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 6
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-a'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      CidrBlock: !Select
        - 2
        - !Cidr
          - !Ref VpcCidr
          - 6
          - 8
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-b'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  NatElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Ingress restricted to the container port and self-referencing traffic within the VPC CIDR; egress left as the AWS default allow-all rule for NAT gateway, endpoint, and ECS control plane access.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Container port traffic from within the VPC CIDR range
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
        - Description: HTTPS traffic to VPC endpoints from within the VPC CIDR range
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-container-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ContainerSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow all traffic between containers and VPC endpoint ENIs that share this security group
      IpProtocol: '-1'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecr-api-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcsAgentEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs-agent'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-agent-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcsTelemetryEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecs-telemetry'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-telemetry-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  DefaultTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateDefaultTaskRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Description: !Sub 'Default task role for the ${ServiceName} containers (no additional permissions). Override with the CustomTaskRoleArn parameter to grant access to other AWS resources.'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.internal'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for service discovery in the ${EnvironmentName} environment.'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
      Description: !Sub 'SRV-based discovery service for ${ServiceName}.'
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 15
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ServiceTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - UseCustomTaskRole
        - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
        - !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: app
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ContainerLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: PrivateRoute
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ServiceTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PropagateTags: SERVICE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
            - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: app
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort

  ServiceScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: EcsService
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster/${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-graduated-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 30
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 30
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 60
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 60
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  HighCpuScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cpu-high-scale-out'
      AlarmDescription: Fires when average service CPU utilization is at or above 70 percent. Graduated scale-out steps - add 1 task for 70-100 percent CPU, 2 tasks for 100-130 percent, and 3 tasks above 130 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  LowCpuScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cpu-low-scale-in'
      AlarmDescription: Fires when average service CPU utilization stays at or below 20 percent for 15 consecutive minutes; removes one task while the alarm is breaching.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 15
      DatapointsToAlarm: 15
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC created by this stack.
    Value: !Ref VPC

  EcsClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster hosting the microservice.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !Ref EcsService

  ServiceDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Description: DNS name other services in this VPC can use to discover this microservice (resolves to SRV records).
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.internal'

  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service backing the private DNS SRV records.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn

  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by the containers.
    Value: !If
      - UseCustomTaskRole
      - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
      - !GetAtt DefaultTaskRole.Arn

  ContainerLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group that receives container logs.
    Value: !Ref ContainerLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained hybrid interconnect demonstration network backbone for an OCI
  primary region. Deploys a VPC, an internet gateway, a private subnet in the
  first available availability zone, a route table with an internet-gateway
  default route, a transit gateway with a VPC attachment, an HTTPS-only
  security group, an optional customer gateway and static-routed Site-to-Site
  VPN connection to OCI with a transit gateway route for the OCI backbone CIDR,
  and VPC flow logs encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (rotation
  enabled) delivered to a CloudWatch Logs group with 30-day retention. All
  CIDRs are parameterized.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: HTTPS security perimeter
        Parameters:
          - InternalHttpsCidr
          - OciBackboneCidr
      - Label:
          default: Optional OCI VPN interconnect
        Parameters:
          - EnableOciVpn
          - OciCustomerGatewayIpAddress
          - OciCustomerGatewayAsn
    ParameterLabels:
      VpcCidr:
        default: VPC CIDR
      SubnetCidr:
        default: Private subnet CIDR
      InternalHttpsCidr:
        default: Internal HTTPS ingress CIDR
      OciBackboneCidr:
        default: OCI backbone CIDR
      EnableOciVpn:
        default: Create OCI VPN
      OciCustomerGatewayIpAddress:
        default: OCI customer gateway public IP
      OciCustomerGatewayAsn:
        default: OCI customer gateway ASN

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the demonstration VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in x.x.x.x/nn format.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet (must fall inside the VPC CIDR).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in x.x.x.x/nn format.
  InternalHttpsCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: Internal CIDR range allowed to initiate inbound HTTPS (443).
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in x.x.x.x/nn format.
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.99.0.0/16
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR used as the only HTTPS egress destination, as the VPN static route destination, and as the transit gateway route destination.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block in x.x.x.x/nn format.
  EnableOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the customer gateway, the static-routed VPN connection to OCI, and the transit gateway route for OCI traffic.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  OciCustomerGatewayIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Public IPv4 address of the OCI VPN termination device (DRG). Required when EnableOciVpn is true.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IPv4 address.
  OciCustomerGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 31898
    Description: BGP ASN configured on the OCI customer gateway device (31898 is the default OCI DRG ASN). Required by AWS even when static routes are used.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967295

Conditions:
  EnableOciVpn: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableOciVpn
    - 'true'

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VpcInternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az1'

  VpcRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-route-table'

  InternetDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref VpcRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  OciBackboneVpcRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: EnableOciVpn
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref VpcRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref VpcRouteTable

  HttpsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        HTTPS-only security group for the hybrid OCI interconnect demo.
        Inbound limited to 443/tcp from the internal CIDR; outbound limited to
        443/tcp to the OCI backbone CIDR.
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalHttpsCidr
          Description: Inbound HTTPS from the internal CIDR range
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: Outbound HTTPS to the OCI backbone CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-https-only-sg'

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Description: Transit gateway for the hybrid OCI interconnect demonstration
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-route-table'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

  VpnAttachmentLookupLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: EnableOciVpn
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${VpnAttachmentLookupFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  VpnAttachmentLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableOciVpn
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                Resource: '*'

  VpnAttachmentLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: EnableOciVpn
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupRole.Arn
      Description: Resolves the transit gateway attachment ID created for the OCI VPN connection.
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import time

          POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 10
          MAX_WAIT_SECONDS = 240
          PHYSICAL_ID = "vpn-tgw-attachment-lookup"


          def handler(event, context):
              if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, PHYSICAL_ID)
                  return
              try:
                  transit_gateway_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["TransitGatewayId"]
                  vpn_connection_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["VpnConnectionId"]
                  ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
                  deadline = time.time() + MAX_WAIT_SECONDS
                  attachment_id = None
                  while time.time() < deadline:
                      response = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_attachments(
                          Filters=[
                              {"Name": "transit-gateway-id", "Values": [transit_gateway_id]},
                              {"Name": "resource-id", "Values": [vpn_connection_id]},
                              {"Name": "resource-type", "Values": ["vpn"]},
                          ]
                      )
                      attachments = response.get("TransitGatewayAttachments", [])
                      if attachments:
                          attachment_id = attachments[0]["TransitGatewayAttachmentId"]
                          break
                      time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
                  if not attachment_id:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          "Timed out waiting for the transit gateway VPN attachment for "
                          + vpn_connection_id
                      )
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                      {"AttachmentId": attachment_id}, PHYSICAL_ID,
                  )
              except Exception as lookup_error:
                  print("Transit gateway attachment lookup failed: %s" % lookup_error)
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {"Error": str(lookup_error)}, PHYSICAL_ID,
                  )

  VpnTgwAttachmentLookup:
    Type: Custom::VpnTgwAttachment
    Condition: EnableOciVpn

      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  FlowLogsKmsKey:

            Action:

              - kms:Encrypt

              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:

  FlowLogsLogGroup:

  request latency, account/table-level capacity utilization, and replication
  health.

Resources:

  TestUserTable:

      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:

        SSEEnabled: true

  ########################################################################

      AlarmDescription: Alarms when write requests to the test table are throttled by DynamoDB.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TestUserTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  PiBot Cognito authentication infrastructure. Creates two independent Cognito
  setups: (1) a main web application setup with a user pool, user pool client,
  an identity pool that allows unauthenticated access, and authenticated and
  unauthenticated IAM roles granting common IoT operations, Kinesis Video
  streaming actions, Rekognition label detection, and standard Cognito and
  mobile analytics actions; and (2) an IoT trusted user provisioning setup with
  a user pool, user pool client, identity pool, and roles where the
  authenticated role grants IoT trusted user provisioning actions.

Resources:

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Setup 1: Main web application
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------

  MainWebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotMainWebAppUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: PiBot

  MainWebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotMainWebAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  MainWebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotMainWebAppIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt MainWebAppUserPool.ProviderName

  MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Authenticated user role for the PiBot main web application
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotMainWebAppAuthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoAndMobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CommonIoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:ListFragments
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:TagStream
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot

  MainWebAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Unauthenticated guest role for the PiBot main web application
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotMainWebAppUnauthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoAndMobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CommonIoTOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:ListFragments
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:TagStream
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot

  MainWebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------
  # Setup 2: IoT trusted user provisioning
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------

  IoTProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotIoTProvisioningUserPool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: PiBot

  IoTProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotIoTProvisioningClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  IoTProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotIoTProvisioningIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt IoTProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName

  IoTProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Authenticated user role granting IoT trusted user provisioning actions
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotIoTTrustedUserProvisioningAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: IoTTrustedUserProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:*Provisioning*
                  - iot:*Thing*
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:CreateCertificateFromCsr
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot

  IoTProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Unauthenticated guest role for the PiBot IoT provisioning identity pool
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotIoTProvisioningUnauthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CognitoAndMobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot

  IoTProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IoTProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt IoTProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt IoTProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:

  MainWebAppIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the PiBot main web application
    Value: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool

  MainWebAppUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the PiBot main web application
    Value: !Ref MainWebAppUserPool

  MainWebAppUserPoolClientId:

  IoTProvisioningIdentityPoolId:

  IoTProvisioningUserPoolId:

  IoTProvisioningUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User pool client ID for PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning
    Value: !Ref IoTProvisioningUserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration supporting an AI
  agent for protein variant effect prediction. Deploys a self-contained greenfield stack: a
  stand-in prediction Lambda implementing the invoke_endpoint and get_results tool operations, a
  Cognito user pool and app client backing the gateway custom JWT authorizer, the gateway
  execution IAM role trusted by bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com with permission to invoke the
  prediction Lambda, the gateway itself, and a Lambda gateway target with an inline MCP tool
  schema. The gateway execution role ARN is published to a standard SSM String parameter created
  by this template.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Project And Gateway Configuration
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - GatewayName
          - GatewayDescription
    ParameterLabels:
      ProjectName:
        default: Project Name
      GatewayName:
        default: Gateway Name (Optional)
      GatewayDescription:
        default: Gateway Description

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,49}$"
    Description: Project name used to derive resource names and the SSM parameter path that stores the gateway role ARN.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^(|[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,99})$"
    Description: Optional explicit AgentCore Gateway name. If left blank, the name auto-generates as "<ProjectName>-gateway".

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway exposing MCP tools for protein variant effect prediction
    Description: Human-readable description applied to the AgentCore Gateway.

Conditions:
  UseCustomGatewayName: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - ""

Resources:
  PredictionLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the stand-in protein variant effect prediction Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: protein-prediction

  PredictionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Stand-in protein variant effect prediction backend implementing the invoke_endpoint (submit sequence and variant, return job identifier) and get_results (check job completion) operations.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt PredictionLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import uuid


          def handler(event, context):
              operation = event.get("operation")
              if not operation:
                  operation = "get_results" if "job_id" in event else "invoke_endpoint"

              if operation == "invoke_endpoint":
                  sequence = str(event.get("sequence") or "")
                  position = int(event.get("variant_position") or 0)
                  residue = str(event.get("variant_residue") or "")
                  model_version = str(event.get("model_version") or "default")
                  if not sequence or not residue or position < 1:
                      raise ValueError(
                          "sequence, variant_position (>=1) and variant_residue are required"
                      )
                  job_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  score = round(((position * 7) % 100) / 100.0, 4)
                  return {
                      "job_id": job_id,
                      "status": "COMPLETED",
                      "input": {
                          "sequence_length": len(sequence),
                          "variant_position": position,
                          "variant_residue": residue,
                          "model_version": model_version,
                      },
                      "result": {
                          "predicted_effect_score": score,
                          "classification": (
                              "deleterious" if score >= 0.5 else "tolerated"
                          ),
                      },
                  }

              if operation == "get_results":
                  job_id = str(event.get("job_id") or "")
                  if not job_id:
                      raise ValueError("job_id is required")
                  return {"job_id": job_id, "status": "COMPLETED"}

              raise ValueError("Unsupported operation: " + str(operation))
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: protein-prediction

  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-gateway-users"
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway

  CognitoUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-gateway-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  GatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com to invoke the protein variant effect prediction Lambda target.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAgentCoreServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeProteinPredictionLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokePredictionFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt PredictionFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub "${PredictionFunction.Arn}:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: agentcore-gateway

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway/role-arn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Audit event messaging stack. Creates a KMS-encrypted SQS queue for audit
  events using a customer managed key with automatic rotation, an optional
  dead-letter queue enabled only in non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms
  for oldest-message age and DLQ activity, and an SNS topic for alarm
  notifications. Message retention and visibility timeout are configured
  per environment.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Target deployment environment.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    ConstraintDescription: Environment must be one of dev, test, staging, prod.

  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Optional email address subscribed to the alarm notification topic.
      Leave empty to create the topic without an email subscription.
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^([A-Za-z0-9_\-\.+]+)@([A-Za-z0-9\-]+\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Value must be empty or a valid email address.

  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: >
      Number of receive attempts before a message is moved to the
      dead-letter queue (applies when the DLQ is enabled).
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100

  OldestMessageAlarmThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Description: >
      Maximum acceptable age (in seconds) of the oldest message in the
      audit queue before the backlog-age alarm fires.
    Default: 3600
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 86400

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 86400
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
    test:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 604800
      VisibilityTimeout: 180
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 300

Conditions:
  IsNonDevEnvironment: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, "dev"]]
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, ""]]

Resources:
  AuditQueueKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for ${Environment} audit event SQS queues"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamPolicyDelegation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"

  AuditQueueKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-audit-sqs"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKmsKey

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNonDevEnvironment
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-audit-events-dlq"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-events-dlq

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-audit-events"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap
        - EnvironmentConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap
        - EnvironmentConfig
        - !Ref Environment
        - VisibilityTimeout
      ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds: 10
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDevEnvironment
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-events

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-audit-alarms"
      DisplayName: !Sub "${Environment} audit alarms"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-alarm-notifications

  AlarmNotificationEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  AuditQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-audit-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Fires when the oldest message in the ${Environment} audit events queue is older than the configured threshold, indicating a stuck or unprocessed backlog."
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: !Ref OldestMessageAlarmThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AuditDeadLetterQueueActivityAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNonDevEnvironment
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-${Environment}-audit-dlq-activity"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "Fires when any message appears in the ${Environment} audit events dead-letter queue, indicating failed message processing."
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the KMS-encrypted audit events queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue
  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
  AuditEventsQueueName:
    Description: Name of the audit events queue (for CloudWatch metric dimensions and clients).
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Condition: IsNonDevEnvironment
    Description: ARN of the dead-letter queue (created only in non-dev environments).
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn
  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving CloudWatch alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
  AuditQueueKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key protecting the queues and alarm topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueueKmsKey.Arn
