AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API (CryptoTickerAPI) for cryptocurrency ticker data. Query.ticker fetches the current USD price from CoinGecko via an HTTP data source and stores a historical price record in the APIDataTable DynamoDB table using a two-function pipeline resolver. TickerInfo.priceHistory queries the table for all records matching the ticker, sorted in descending order by the range key, with a default limit of 25 items and nextToken pagination."

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: "Service role assumed by AWS AppSync to interact with the APIDataTable DynamoDB table"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CryptoTickerGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          symbol: String!
          price: Float
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float
          timestamp: String!
        }

  CryptoTickerApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: "Default API key for CryptoTickerAPI"

  APIDataTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: "DynamoDB data source backed by the APIDataTable table"
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
        Versioned: false

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: "HTTP data source for the CoinGecko simple price endpoint"
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: "https://api.coingecko.com"

  GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - CoinGeckoDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: GetCoinGeckoPrice
      Description: "Fetches the current USD price for the requested ticker from CoinGecko"
      DataSourceName: CoinGeckoDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "headers": {
              "Content-Type": "application/json"
            },
            "query": {
              "ids": "$util.urlEncode($ctx.args.symbol)",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set( $price = 0 )
        #if( $ctx.result )
          #set( $priceMap = $ctx.result.get($ctx.args.symbol) )
          #set( $price = $util.defaultIfNull($priceMap.usd, 0) )
        #end
        {
          "symbol": $util.toJson($ctx.args.symbol),
          "price": $price
        }

  StorePriceHistoryFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - APIDataTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: StorePriceHistory
      Description: "Stores the fetched price snapshot as a historical record in APIDataTable"
      DataSourceName: APIDataTableDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set( $now = $util.time.nowISO8601() )
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.symbol),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($now)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.symbol),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($now)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetCoinGeckoPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StorePriceHistoryFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {}
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - APIDataTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: APIDataTableDataSource
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set( $limit = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25) )
        #set( $nextToken = $ctx.args.nextToken )
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.symbol)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit#if($nextToken),
          "nextToken": "${nextToken}"#end
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "items": $util.toJson($ctx.result.items),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.result.nextToken)
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: "GraphQL endpoint for the CryptoTickerAPI"
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiKey:
    Description: "Default API key for the CryptoTickerAPI"
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerApiKey.ApiKey
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table storing historical price records"
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  AWS Elemental MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin
  endpoints, conditional live-to-VOD origination control (origination set to
  DENY when an archive bucket is supplied), and optional VOD packaging
  workflows backed by an IAM role that allows MediaPackage to access the VOD
  source and live-to-VOD archive Amazon S3 buckets, which are encrypted with
  a customer managed KMS key created in this template.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage-live
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,40}$
    ConstraintDescription: NamePrefix may contain only letters, numbers and hyphens (1-40 characters).
    Description: Logical name prefix used to name the resources created by this template.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: >-
      Output type for the live workflow. APPLE_HLS creates the HLS origin endpoint,
      ISO_DASH creates the DASH origin endpoint, and ALL creates both endpoints.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$
    ConstraintDescription: ManifestName may contain only letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens.
    Description: Manifest name (without file extension) used by the HLS and DASH origin endpoints.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 2
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS origin endpoint.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    Description: Startover window in seconds applied to both origin endpoints.

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "(^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$)"
    ConstraintDescription: ArchiveBucket must be empty or a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: >-
      Name of the Amazon S3 bucket used for live-to-VOD archive storage. When supplied,
      this template creates the bucket, sets origin endpoint origination to DENY to
      support live-to-VOD workflows, and grants MediaPackage write access.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "(^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$)"
    ConstraintDescription: VodSourceBucket must be empty or a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: >-
      Name of the Amazon S3 bucket holding the VOD source content. When supplied, this
      template creates the bucket and grants MediaPackage read access for VOD packaging.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Value applied to the Environment tag on every resource.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional key of an additional custom key-value tag applied to every resource.

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional value of the additional custom key-value tag (requires CustomTagKey).

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, ""]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, ""]
  HasCustomTag: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagValue, ""]]
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "APPLE_HLS"]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ALL"]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ISO_DASH"]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ALL"]
  ProvisionVodWorkflow: !Or
    - Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    - Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
  CreateVodHlsPackaging: !And
    - Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    - Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
  CreateVodDashPackaging: !And
    - Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    - Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow

Resources:
  LiveChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-channel"
      Description: !Sub "Live streaming channel for ${NamePrefix}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-hls-endpoint"
      ChannelId: !Ref LiveChannel
      Description: !Sub "HLS origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-dash-endpoint"
      ChannelId: !Ref LiveChannel
      Description: !Sub "DASH origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix}"
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  LiveToVodArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  VodSourceContentBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  MediaPackageKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer managed key for SSE-KMS encryption of the MediaPackage VOD source
        content bucket and the live-to-VOD archive bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - !If
            - ProvisionVodWorkflow
            - Sid: AllowMediaPackageAccessRoleObjectOperations
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !GetAtt MediaPackageAccessRole.Arn
              Action:
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:Encrypt
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
                - kms:ReEncrypt*
                - kms:DescribeKey
              Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  MediaPackageAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-access"
      Description: Allows AWS Elemental MediaPackage to read VOD source content from Amazon S3 and write live-to-VOD harvests to the archive bucket.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: MediaPackageBucketLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - HasVodSourceBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                  - !If
                    - HasArchiveBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
              - Sid: MediaPackageObjectLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - HasVodSourceBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
                  - !If
                    - HasArchiveBucket
                    - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*"
                    - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-packaging-group"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  VodHlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodHlsPackaging
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-hls-config"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        HlsManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  VodDashPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodDashPackaging
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-vod-dash-config"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

Outputs:
  LiveChannelId:
    Description: ID of the MediaPackage live channel.
    Value: !Ref LiveChannel
  HlsOriginEndpointId:
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Description: ID of the HLS origin endpoint.
    Value: !Ref HlsOriginEndpoint
  DashOriginEndpointId:
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Description: ID of the DASH origin endpoint.
    Value: !Ref DashOriginEndpoint
  LiveToVodArchiveBucketName:
    Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    Description: Name of the live-to-VOD archive bucket.
    Value: !Ref LiveToVodArchiveBucket
  VodSourceContentBucketName:
    Condition: HasVodSourceBucket
    Description: Name of the VOD source content bucket.
    Value: !Ref VodSourceContentBucket
  MediaPackageKmsKeyArn:
    Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the VOD source and archive buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageKmsKey.Arn
  MediaPackageAccessRoleArn:
    Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by MediaPackage to access the VOD source and archive buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageAccessRole.Arn
  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Condition: ProvisionVodWorkflow
    Description: ID of the MediaPackage VOD packaging group.
    Value: !Ref VodPackagingGroup

  for the Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) to manage the full lifecycle of both
  EC2-based and EKS-based Kubernetes clusters. Creates a control plane role, a
  controllers role, and a nodes role (each with a corresponding instance
  profile), plus a separate EKS control plane role.

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Cluster API Provider AWS control plane role assumed by EC2 instances

      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: capa-control-plane
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: cloudformation

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Cluster API Provider AWS controllers role assumed by EC2 instances and
        by EKS pods (pods.eks.amazonaws.com) running the cluster controllers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: capa-controllers
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: cloudformation

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipelines that bake custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64 and
  arm64 with Docker, Docker Compose, and Python packages (synapseclient, pandas,
  pysftp), grant passwordless sudo to the ssm-user, and distribute the resulting AMIs
  publicly and to the specified AWS Organization. Output AMIs are tagged with the
  originating stack name. The latest Amazon Linux 2023 base AMI per architecture is
  discovered at deploy time by an in-template Lambda custom resource calling
  ec2:DescribeImages (no SSM dependency, no hardcoded AMI IDs). Build instances run
  in private subnets with no public IP auto-assignment; connectivity is provided by
  SSM/S3 VPC endpoints and a NAT gateway, and the build security group permits HTTPS
  egress only to explicitly scoped destinations (VPC CIDR, PyPI/Fastly package
  ranges, and Amazon S3 ranges serving the Amazon Linux 2023 repositories).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image version and storage
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Organization sharing
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationId
    ParameterLabels:
      ImageVersion:
        default: Image version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
      RootVolumeSize:
        default: Root volume size (GiB)
      OrganizationId:
        default: AWS Organization ID

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Description: Semantic version applied to the Image Builder component and image recipes.
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Image version must use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semantic versioning (for example, 1.0.0).
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Description: Root EBS volume size (GiB) baked into the output AMIs.
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    ConstraintDescription: Root volume size must be between 8 and 1024 GiB.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      AWS Organizations ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx) with which the AMIs are shared. Replace the
      default with the organization ID whose management account is the deployment account.
    Default: o-0000000000
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-zA-Z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Organization ID must match the format o-xxxxxxxxxx.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network for Image Builder build instances (private build subnet + NAT egress)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-vpc"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-igw"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderInternetGateway

  ImageBuilderBuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-build-subnet"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderNatGatewaySubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-nat-subnet"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Internet-facing route table serves only the NAT gateway subnet (NAT uses an EIP,
  # not auto-assigned public IPs, so MapPublicIpOnLaunch stays false there too).
  ImageBuilderNatGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-nat-subnet-rt"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderIgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: ImageBuilderVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderInternetGateway

  ImageBuilderNatGatewaySubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGatewaySubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGatewayRouteTable

  # Build subnet routes through the NAT gateway for internet egress (PyPI, S3).
  ImageBuilderBuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-build-rt"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderNatGatewayElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  ImageBuilderNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: ImageBuilderIgwRoute
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ImageBuilderNatGatewayElasticIp.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGatewaySubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-natgw"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # The !Ref on NatGatewayId already enforces creation order; no explicit DependsOn.
  ImageBuilderNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderBuildRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref ImageBuilderNatGateway

  ImageBuilderBuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref ImageBuilderBuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref ImageBuilderBuildRouteTable

  # S3 gateway endpoint keeps in-region S3 traffic (AL2023 repositories, Image
  # Builder artifacts) inside the AWS network from the build subnet.
  ImageBuilderS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderBuildRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS-only egress for build instances, restricted to VPC CIDR, PyPI/Fastly ranges, and AL2023 repository S3 ranges.
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to VPC-internal SSM and S3 interface endpoint ENIs
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref PyPIPackageMirrorPrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to Fastly ranges serving pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref Al2023RepositoryS3PrefixList
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon S3 ranges serving the Amazon Linux 2023 repositories
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-sg"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Rationale
          Value: >-
            Egress is restricted to HTTPS toward the VPC CIDR (SSM and S3 PrivateLink
            endpoints), the Fastly/PyPI package ranges, and the Amazon S3 ranges serving
            the Amazon Linux 2023 repositories. No unrestricted egress is permitted.

  ImageBuilderEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        Security group for VPC interface endpoint ENIs. Accepts HTTPS only from the
        build VPC CIDR; all other traffic is denied.
      VpcId: !Ref ImageBuilderVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS from build instances to endpoint ENIs
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS responses to build instances within the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-image-builder-endpoint-sg"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Explicit, non-catch-all destination prefix lists for required public egress
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PyPIPackageMirrorPrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:
      PrefixListName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pypi-fastly-https"

        - Cidr: 103.244.50.0/24

        - Cidr: 103.245.222.0/23
          Description: Fastly CDN serving pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org
        - Cidr: 103.245.224.0/24

  Al2023RepositoryS3PrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Base image discovery: an in-template Lambda custom resource queries
  # ec2:DescribeImages for the newest available Amazon Linux 2023 AMI per
  # architecture. This replaces all SSM-based resolution mechanisms (typed
  # parameters, bare SSM paths, SSM parameter ARNs), none of which are viable in
  # this environment. The lookup uses EC2 APIs only, requires no VPC, and hands
  # ParentImage a literal AMI ID — a natively accepted ParentImage format.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AmiLookupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the AL2023 latest-AMI lookup Lambda custom resource.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ami-lookup-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeImages
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-ami-lookup*"
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AmiLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ami-lookup"
      Description: >-
        Custom resource handler that discovers the latest available Amazon Linux 2023
        AMI ID per architecture via ec2:DescribeImages. Runs outside any VPC; reaches
        the EC2 API over AWS-owned networking.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt AmiLookupLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import urllib.request

          SUCCESS = "SUCCESS"
          FAILED = "FAILED"


          def send_response(event, context, status, physical_id, data=None, reason=""):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or "See CloudWatch Logs: {} {}".format(
                      context.log_group_name, context.log_stream_name
                  ),
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
                  method="PUT",
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10)


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  properties = event.get("ResourceProperties", {}) or {}
                  architecture = properties.get("Architecture", "")
                  physical_id = (
                      "al2023-latest-{}".format(architecture)
                      if architecture
                      else event["PhysicalResourceId"]
                  )

                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      send_response(
                          event, context, SUCCESS, physical_id, {},
                          "Delete acknowledged; the lookup is stateless",
                      )
                      return

                  if architecture not in ("x86_64", "arm64"):
                      raise ValueError(
                          "Unsupported Architecture property: {}".format(architecture)
                      )

                  ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")
                  response = ec2.describe_images(
                      Owners=["amazon"],
                      Filters=[
                          {"Name": "name", "Values": ["al2023-ami-*-kernel-*"]},
                          {"Name": "architecture", "Values": [architecture]},
                          {"Name": "state", "Values": ["available"]},
                          {"Name": "root-device-type", "Values": ["ebs"]},
                          {"Name": "virtualization-type", "Values": ["hvm"]},
                      ],
                  )

                  images = sorted(
                      response.get("Images", []),
                      key=lambda image: image["CreationDate"],
                      reverse=True,
                  )
                  if not images:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          "No available Amazon Linux 2023 AMI found for architecture {}".format(
                              architecture
                          )
                      )

                  ami_id = images[0]["ImageId"]
                  send_response(
                      event, context, SUCCESS, physical_id,
                      {"AmiId": ami_id},
                      "Latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI for {}: {}".format(architecture, ami_id),
                  )
              except Exception as exc:
                  send_response(
                      event, context, FAILED,
                      event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "al2023-ami-lookup-failed"),
                      {},
                      "{}: {}".format(type(exc).__name__, exc),
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  LatestAl2023X86Ami:
    Type: Custom::LatestAl2023Ami
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt AmiLookupFunction.Arn
      Architecture: x86_64

  LatestAl2023Arm64Ami:
    Type: Custom::LatestAl2023Ami
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt AmiLookupFunction.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Software installation and test component (shared by both architectures).
  # Docker and Docker Compose are installed from the AL2023 repositories via dnf,
  # so the only public package destination is PyPI.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Al2023SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-al2023-software"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: >-
        Installs Docker and the Docker Compose plugin from the Amazon Linux 2023
        repositories, the Python packages synapseclient, pandas, and pysftp from
        PyPI, grants passwordless sudo access to the ssm-user, and verifies the
        installation during the image test phase.
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Data: |
        name: al2023-docker-python-ssm
        description: Install Docker and the Docker Compose plugin from AL2023 repositories, Python packages from PyPI, and configure ssm-user sudo access
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallCorePackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker docker-compose-plugin python3-pip
              - name: EnableDockerService
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - systemctl enable docker
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp || python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - id -u ssm-user > /dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash ssm-user
                    - echo "ssm-user ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/90-ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/90-ssm-user
                    - visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/90-ssm-user
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker --version
                    - docker compose version
              - name: VerifyPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('Python package imports verified')"
              - name: VerifySsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - runuser -u ssm-user -- sudo -n whoami | grep -qx root
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipes (one per architecture; platform is inherited from ParentImage).
  # ParentImage receives a literal AMI ID returned by the Custom::LatestAl2023Ami
  # lookup resources (ec2:DescribeImages, Owners=["amazon"], sorted by

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:

      Components:

            Encrypted: false
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName

      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication system. Cognito User Pool
  (PLUS tier with enforced advanced security), email username attribute,
  admin-only user creation, custom attributes (guest_id, property_id, region),
  a strong password policy, and email-based account recovery. Includes a public
  SRP SPA client, a dedicated admin server-side client (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH),
  an M2M client-credentials OAuth2 client backed by a dedicated resource server
  with read/write/admin scopes, six staff groups, and a hosted UI domain scoped
  by environment and account ID.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment, used in resource names and the user pool domain.

Conditions:
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, "prod"]

Resources:
  HotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-users"
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsProd, "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE"]
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Priority: 1
            Name: verified_email
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Schema:
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "256"
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "256"
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: "1"
            MaxLength: "256"

  HotelResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Identifier: hotel-api
      Name: AnyCompany Hotel API
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel guest, property, and reservation data.
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel guest, property, and reservation data.
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AnyCompany Hotel tenant management operations.

  SpaClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-spa"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  AdminAuthClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-admin"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: HotelResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m"
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - hotel-api/read
        - hotel-api/write
        - hotel-api/admin
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
      AccessTokenValidity: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}"

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Description: Platform administrators with full system access.
      Precedence: 1

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Description: Property managers overseeing day-to-day operations.
      Precedence: 10

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Description: Regional managers overseeing multiple properties.
      Precedence: 20

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Description: Revenue managers managing pricing, rates, and forecasting.
      Precedence: 30

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Description: Front desk staff handling check-in, check-out, and guest services.
      Precedence: 40

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref HotelUserPool
      Description: Housekeeping staff managing room status and cleaning schedules.
      Precedence: 50

    Description: Cognito user pool ID.
    Value: !Ref HotelUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN.
    Value: !GetAtt HotelUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"

  UserPoolProviderUrl:
    Description: Cognito user pool issuer/provider URL for JWT validation.
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${HotelUserPool}"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolProviderUrl"

  SpaClientId:
    Description: Public SPA app client ID (SRP auth, no secret).
    Value: !Ref SpaClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SpaClientId"

  AdminClientId:
    Description: Dedicated admin app client ID (ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, with secret).
    Value: !Ref AdminAuthClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminClientId"

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights (prod) Amazon Cognito user pool with an application
  client configured for a 24-hour session (refresh token) timeout, a Python
  post-authentication Lambda trigger that stamps the custom:last_login
  attribute, Admin / RegularUser / PowerUser groups with precedence 1 / 2 / 3,
  a hosted UI custom domain, and optional SAML SSO federation that stays
  disabled while the SSO parameters are left empty.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment of the Hospitality Insights application.

  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      The hosted UI domain prefix must be 3-63 lowercase alphanumeric
      characters or hyphens and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: >-
      Globally unique prefix of the Cognito hosted UI domain
      (<prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com).

  AppCallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://hospitality-insights-prod.example.com/auth/callback
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+'
    ConstraintDescription: The callback URL must start with http:// or https://.
    Description: Redirect URI where the hosted UI sends users after sign-in.

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[A-Za-z0-9_.+=@-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      The SSO provider name may be empty (SSO disabled) or up to 32
      alphanumeric characters including . _ + = @ -.
    Description: >-
      Name of the federated SAML identity provider. Leave empty (default) to
      disable SSO.

  SSOLoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^https?://.+'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      The SSO login URL may be empty (SSO disabled) or an http(s) URL.
    Description: >-
      SAML identity provider metadata (login) URL used for SSO federation.
      Leave empty (default) to disable SSO.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application environment
        Parameters:
          - Environment
      - Label:
          default: Hosted UI
        Parameters:
          - HostedUIDomainPrefix
          - AppCallbackURL
      - Label:
          default: Optional single sign-on (SSO)
        Parameters:
          - SSOProviderName
          - SSOLoginURL
    ParameterLabels:
      Environment:
        default: Environment
      HostedUIDomainPrefix:
        default: Hosted UI domain prefix
      AppCallbackURL:
        default: Post sign-in callback URL
      SSOProviderName:
        default: SSO provider name
      SSOLoginURL:
        default: SSO login (SAML metadata) URL

Conditions:
  SSOEnabled: !And
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref SSOProviderName
        - ''
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref SSOLoginURL
        - ''

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "hospitality-insights-${Environment}"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt LastLoginFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: HospitalityInsights
        Environment: !Ref Environment

  LastLoginFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUpdateLastLogin
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: UpdateLastLoginAttribute
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LastLoginFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "hospitality-insights-${Environment}-post-auth-last-login"
      Description: >-
        Post-authentication trigger that stamps the custom:last_login
        attribute with the current UTC timestamp on every successful sign-in.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 15
      Role: !GetAtt LastLoginFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              user = event.get("userName")
              print("Post-authentication trigger invoked for user: %s" % user)
              try:
                  last_login = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
                  cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=event["userPoolId"],
                      Username=user,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": last_login}
                      ],
                  )
                  print("Updated custom:last_login for user: %s" % user)
              except Exception as error:
                  print("Failed to update custom:last_login for user %s: %s" % (user, error))
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: HospitalityInsights
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LastLoginFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LastLoginFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "hospitality-insights-${Environment}-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AppCallbackURL
      DefaultRedirectURI: !Ref AppCallbackURL
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If [SSOEnabled, [COGNITO, !Ref SamlIdentityProvider], [COGNITO]]

  HostedUIDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref HostedUIDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Administrators of the Hospitality Insights application.
      Precedence: 1

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Regular users of the Hospitality Insights application.
      Precedence: 2

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Power users of the Hospitality Insights application.
      Precedence: 3

  SamlIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: SSOEnabled
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SSOLoginURL
        IDPSignout: "true"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights application client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  HostedUIURL:
    Description: Hosted UI sign-in domain for the application.
    Value: !Sub "https://${HostedUIDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  PostAuthenticationLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda trigger.
    Value: !GetAtt LastLoginFunction.Arn
  FederatedSSOProviderName:
    Description: Federated SSO provider name (reports SSO disabled when unset).
    Value: !If
      - SSOEnabled
      - !Ref SSOProviderName
      - "SSO disabled"

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) chaos engineering experiment that blocks
  application network traffic from the local deployment Region to a target
  Region and pauses S3 and DynamoDB cross-region replication for resources
  tagged ChaosAllowed=true. Provisions the FIS experiment role and policies, a
  dedicated KMS key, and a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group for
  experiment logging.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Chaos experiment configuration
        Parameters:
          - TargetRegion
          - PauseReplicationDurationSeconds
    ParameterLabels:
      TargetRegion:
        default: Target Region
      PauseReplicationDurationSeconds:
        default: Disruption and pause duration (seconds)

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: >-
      The AWS Region to which application network traffic is blocked from the
      local deployment Region. This value must differ from the Region into
      which the stack is deployed, because FIS excludes the local (deployment)
      Region from valid cross-region disruption targets — a cross-region
      connectivity disruption from a Region to itself is not permitted.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be a valid AWS Region code that differs from the deployment Region
      (for example, us-west-2).
  PauseReplicationDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1200
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: >-
      Duration in seconds for which network traffic is disrupted and
      cross-region replication is paused. Defaults to 1200 seconds (20 minutes).

Resources:

  # Dedicated KMS key used to encrypt the experiment CloudWatch log group.
  FisLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Dedicated KMS key used to encrypt the CloudWatch log group that stores
        AWS FIS experiment logs.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIamRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}*'

  # KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group for FIS experiment logging.
  FisExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # IAM role assumed by AWS FIS to execute the experiment actions.
  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by AWS FIS to run the cross-region chaos engineering
        experiment.
      MaxSessionDuration: 43200
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisCrossRegionChaosExperiment
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ResolveChaosTaggedTargets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'tag:GetResources'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeSubnets'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTransitGateways'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeRouteTables'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables'
                  - 's3:ListAllMyBuckets'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketTagging'
                  - 's3:GetBucketVersioning'
                  - 'dynamodb:ListGlobalTables'
                  - 'dynamodb:ListTables'
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable'
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DisruptTransitGatewayAndRouteTableConnectivity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateRoute'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteRoute'
                  - 'ec2:ReplaceRoute'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute'
                  - 'ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PauseS3BucketReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetReplicationConfiguration'
                  - 's3:PutReplicationConfiguration'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed': 'true'
              - Sid: PauseDynamoDbGlobalTableReplication
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable'
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed': 'true'
              - Sid: WriteExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  # FIS experiment template for the multi-service chaos scenario.
  CrossRegionChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Blocks application network traffic from the local deployment Region to
        the target Region and pauses S3 and DynamoDB cross-region replication
        for transit gateways, subnets, S3 buckets, and DynamoDB global tables
        tagged ChaosAllowed=true.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      ExperimentOptions:
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: skip
      StopConditions:
        - Source: 'none'
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      Targets:
        TransitGateways:
          ResourceType: 'aws:ec2:transit-gateway'
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        Subnets:
          ResourceType: 'aws:ec2:subnet'
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        ReplicationBuckets:
          ResourceType: 'aws:s3:bucket'
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
        DynamoDbGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: 'aws:dynamodb:global-table'
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL
      Actions:
        BlockSubnetTrafficToTargetRegion:
          ActionId: 'aws:network:disrupt-cross-region-connectivity'
          Description: >-
            Blocks application network traffic from the tagged subnets to the
            target Region.
          Parameters:
            TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseReplicationDurationSeconds}S'
          Targets:
            Subnets: Subnets
        BlockTransitGatewayTrafficToTargetRegion:
          ActionId: 'aws:network:transit-gateway-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity'
          Description: >-
            Blocks transit gateway connectivity from the tagged transit
            gateways to the target Region.
          Parameters:
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseReplicationDurationSeconds}S'
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGateways
        PauseS3CrossRegionReplication:
          ActionId: 'aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication'
          Description: Pauses S3 cross-region replication for the tagged buckets.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseReplicationDurationSeconds}S'
          Targets:
            Buckets: ReplicationBuckets
        PauseDynamoDbCrossRegionReplication:
          ActionId: 'aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication'
          Description: >-
            Pauses DynamoDB global table cross-region replication for the
            tagged global tables.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${PauseReplicationDurationSeconds}S'
          Targets:
            Tables: DynamoDbGlobalTables
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cross-region-chaos'

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: ID of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref CrossRegionChaosExperimentTemplate
  ExperimentTemplateArn:
    Description: ARN of the FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-template/${CrossRegionChaosExperimentTemplate}'
  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log group used for experiment logging.
    Value: !Ref FisExperimentLogGroup
  ExperimentLogGroupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the dedicated KMS key encrypting the experiment log group.
    Value: !GetAtt FisLogKmsKey.Arn
  FisExperimentRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by AWS FIS when running the experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
