final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke connectivity via AWS Transit
  Gateway. Creates a 10.0.0.0/16 VPC with public and private subnets across two
  Availability Zones, one NAT gateway per public subnet, a Transit Gateway with
  private ASN 64512 (DNS and VPN ECMP enabled) and an explicit TGW route table,
  private subnet routes sending 10.0.0.0/8 traffic toward the Transit Gateway,
  VPC flow logs delivered to an encrypted CloudWatch Logs group, and VPC
  endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs, and S3. Core
  resource IDs are exported for reuse by spoke account stacks.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network Addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Transit Gateway
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayAsn
      - Label:
          default: Flow Logs
        Parameters:
          - FlowLogsRetentionInDays

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Environment name prefix used for resource names, tags, and exports.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][-a-zA-Z0-9]{0,19}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Environment name must start with a letter and contain up to 20 alphanumeric characters or hyphens.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the hub VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.
  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Amazon-side private ASN for the Transit Gateway.
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    ConstraintDescription: ASN must be a private ASN between 64512 and 65534.
  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period (in days) for VPC flow logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-internet-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Network
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Network
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Network
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Network
          Value: private

  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-route-table'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-route-table-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} hub transit gateway for multi-account spoke connectivity'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-transit-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-route-table'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
        Ipv6Support: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  PrivateTransitGatewayRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateTransitGatewayRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key used to encrypt ${EnvironmentName} VPC flow logs'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc*'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsDeliveryEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows the VPC flow logs delivery service to write to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status} ${vpc-id} ${subnet-id} ${type} ${tcp-flags}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Allows HTTPS from the ${EnvironmentName} VPC to interface endpoints'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from the VPC CIDR to interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from interface endpoints to the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-s3-gateway-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2-messages-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cloudwatch-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcCidr'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the internet gateway attached to the hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-InternetGatewayId'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of the public subnets.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of the private subnets.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated IDs of the private route tables.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateRouteTable1, !Ref PrivateRouteTable2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTableIds'

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the hub Transit Gateway.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayId'

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway route table associated with the hub VPC attachment.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayRouteTableId'

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway VPC attachment for the hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayAttachmentId'

    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC flow logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogsLogGroupArn'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 log-based monitoring controls. Creates
  a customer managed KMS key, a CloudTrail trail delivering management events to
  an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group, an encrypted SNS topic for alarm
  notifications, 14 metric filters with companion CloudWatch alarms (threshold 1,
  5 minute period, 1 minute for the KMS control), and companion Logs Insights
  query definitions for each control.

Parameters:
  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the alarm notification SNS topic. Leave empty to skip the subscription.
    AllowedPattern: '(^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$)'
    ConstraintDescription: Value must be empty or a valid email address.

Conditions:
  HasAlarmNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, ""]]

Resources:

  CisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key encrypting the CIS CloudTrail log files, the CloudWatch Logs log group, the CloudTrail S3 bucket, and the alarm notification SNS topic.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:CreateGrant"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/cis-benchmark-trail"
          - Sid: AllowSNSToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToTheEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"

  CisCloudTrailKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-cloudtrail-logging-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisKmsKey

  CisCloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /cis/benchmark/cloudtrail
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CisKmsKey.Arn

  CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by CloudTrail to deliver management events to the CIS CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteCloudTrailEventsToLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CisCloudTrailLogGroup}:*"

  CloudTrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "cis-cloudtrail-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CisKmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for multiple EKS deployments.
  Enables GuardDuty (FIFTEEN_MINUTES findings publishing frequency), creates
  environment-aliased IAM roles for Lambda resource discovery, caller identity
  lookups, EKS node group description, CloudFormation execution, CloudFormation
  registry logging, CodeBuild/EKS integration, CloudFormation extension hooks
  and a bastion instance, and activates the AWSQS Kubernetes Resource, Helm and
  EKS Cluster registry types with dedicated log groups. Fully self-contained:
  every referenced resource is created within this stack, and the public
  registry type ARNs are resolved at deploy time by an in-template custom
  resource rather than hardcoded.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: shared
    Description: >-
      Optional environment alias used as the prefix for every IAM role name
      (for example: shared, dev, prod).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,19}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Environment alias must start with a letter and contain up to 20
      alphanumeric or hyphen characters.
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: '00000000'
    Description: >-
      Optional short hash appended to every IAM role name to disambiguate
      deployments that share the same environment alias.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Environment hash must be 1-12 alphanumeric characters.
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an IAM permissions boundary policy. Leave empty unless
      the target environment requires a permissions boundary. To enforce the
      boundary, uncomment the commented "PermissionsBoundary" property on every
      IAM role in this template and provide this ARN at deploy time.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::[0-9]{12}:policy/[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_/-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: PermissionsBoundaryArn must be empty or a valid IAM managed policy ARN.
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: shared-eks-artifacts
    Description: >-
      Name of the S3 bucket that the bastion role is allowed to read. The
      bastion role's s3:GetObject permission is scoped to this bucket only.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # GuardDuty - enabled region-wide with 15 minute finding publishing
  ############################################################################
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  ############################################################################
  # CloudWatch log groups for CloudFormation registry type logging
  ############################################################################
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 90

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 90

  EksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 90

  ############################################################################
  # Lambda execution role - read-only access for resource discovery
  ############################################################################
  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-discovery-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access for resource discovery.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: resource-discovery-readonly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2ReadOnlyDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksReadOnlyDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:List*
                  - eks:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ListingDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationReadDiscovery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaBasicLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # Lambda role - caller identity plus CloudFormation and CloudTrail logs
  ############################################################################
  LambdaIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-lambda-identity-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Lambda role for GetCallerIdentity and CloudFormation/CloudTrail log access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity-and-audit-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GetCallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudTrailLogAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:*:log-group:CloudTrail*'
              - Sid: LambdaBasicLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # Role for describing EKS node groups
  ############################################################################
  EksNodegroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-eks-nodegroup-describe-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Role for describing and listing EKS clusters and node groups.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: describe-eks-nodegroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeEksNodegroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # CloudFormation execution role (max session 8400s, broad permissions)
  ############################################################################
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-exec-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: CloudFormation execution role for EKS deployments (max session 8400 seconds).
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-execution-broad
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEks
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'eks:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageSecretsManager
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'secretsmanager:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageKms
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'kms:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageS3
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicyStatus
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:PutBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectAcl
                  - s3:PutObjectAcl
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageEc2
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'ec2:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'lambda:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ManageLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'logs:*'
                Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # Logging delivery role for CloudFormation registry logs
  ############################################################################
  CloudFormationLoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-logging-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Logging delivery role used by CloudFormation registry type activations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: registry-log-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RegistryLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:*:log-group:cloudformation/registry/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:*:log-group:awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs*'

  ############################################################################
  # Role for CodeBuild and EKS service integration (ECR, S3, EKS)
  ############################################################################
  CodeBuildEksIntegrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-codebuild-eks-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Role for CodeBuild and EKS service integration with ECR, S3 and EKS access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: codebuild-eks-integration
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPushPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:*:*:repository/*'
              - Sid: S3ArtifactAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksDescribeAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # Role for CloudFormation extension hooks
  ############################################################################
  CloudFormationHooksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-cfn-hooks-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Role for CloudFormation extension hooks (Secrets Manager, KMS, EKS, S3, STS, IAM, EC2, Lambda, logs, CloudWatch, SSM).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-extension-hooks
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                  - secretsmanager:GetResourcePolicy
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:ListKeys
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:Get*
                  - s3:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: StsIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - sts:GetAccessKeyInfo
                  - sts:DecodeAuthorizationMessage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IamRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:Get*
                  - lambda:List*
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:Describe*
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:Describe*
                  - cloudwatch:Get*
                  - cloudwatch:List*
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SsmRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameterHistory
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'

  ############################################################################
  # Bastion instance role (S3 scoped to ArtifactBucketName, ECR, EC2, EKS,
  # CodeBuild, CodePipeline, CloudWatch Logs) plus its instance profile
  ############################################################################
  BastionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: Bastion instance role with scoped S3, ECR, EC2, EKS, CodeBuild, CodePipeline and CloudWatch Logs access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bastion-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ScopedBucketObjectRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArtifactBucketName}/*'
              - Sid: ScopedBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArtifactBucketName}'
              - Sid: EcrAuthorization
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:*:*:repository/*'
              - Sid: Ec2Describe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodeBuildAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:StopBuild
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:BatchGetProjects
                  - codebuild:ListBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListBuildsForProject
                  - codebuild:ListProjects
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodePipelineAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  BastionInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-bastion-profile-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BastionRole

  ############################################################################
  # Registry resolver subsystem.
  # Public registry ARNs embed a registry-issued publisher ID and default
  # version that cannot be derived or verified offline, so no registry ARN
  # literal may be hardcoded in this template. The resources below resolve
  # the current default-version public ARN for each type at deploy time via
  # the two-step registry chain:
  #   Step 1 - ListTypes with Type=RESOURCE, Visibility=PUBLIC and a
  #     Filters={'TypeNamePrefix': <target>} member (the type-name prefix is
  #     a member of the Filters structure, NOT a top-level ListTypes
  #     parameter). ListTypes works for public extensions this account has
  #     never activated. TypeSummaries entries carry NO Arn member - but
  #     they DO carry the registry-issued PublisherId, which is read from
  #     the exact TypeName match.
  #   Step 2 - DescribeType with Type=RESOURCE + TypeName + PublisherId (the
  #     documented form for describing public third-party extensions; by
  #     name alone it resolves against this account's own registry view and
  #     raises TypeNotFoundException for unactivated public types). The full
  #     DescribeTypeSummary response carries the registry-authoritative
  #     default-version Arn along with DefaultVersionId - no ARN is
  #     reconstructed anywhere; both the publisher ID and the ARN come from
  #     the registry.
  #   - PublicTypeArnResolverRole: Lambda execution role with ONLY the two
  #     read-only registry actions (cloudformation:ListTypes and
  #     cloudformation:DescribeType) plus basic CloudWatch Logs permissions.
  #   - PublicTypeArnResolverFunction: inline-ZipFile Lambda implementing the
  #     two-step chain. Real failures are sent as the cfnresponse reason so
  #     they are readable from the stack event.
  #   - PublicTypeArnResolver (Custom::PublicTypeArnResolver): invokes the
  #     function and exposes one ARN attribute per type, consumed via
  #     !GetAtt by the three activations below (which also DependsOn the
  #     resolver so ordering is guaranteed).
  # The resolver is deterministic: pure read-only lookups, no state,
  # paginated ListTypes per type plus one DescribeType call per type. It
  # also self-heals version drift - the activations always target the
  # currently published default version.
  # Optional human cross-check (never a template dependency):
  #   aws cloudformation list-types --type RESOURCE --visibility PUBLIC \
  #     --filters TypeNamePrefix=AWSQS::Kubernetes
  ############################################################################
  PublicTypeArnResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-type-arn-resolver-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: >-
        Lambda execution role for the public type ARN resolver: read-only
        cloudformation:DescribeType and cloudformation:ListTypes plus basic
        CloudWatch Logs permissions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      # PermissionsBoundary (load-bearing for environments that require one):
      # uncomment the line below and provide PermissionsBoundaryArn at deploy
      # time to enforce the boundary on this role.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: registry-read-and-basic-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationRegistryRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaBasicLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PublicTypeArnResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-type-arn-resolver-${EnvironmentHash}'
      Description: >-
        Resolves the current default-version public ARN for each AWSQS
        registry type via the two-step registry chain: ListTypes (Visibility
        PUBLIC, Filters.TypeNamePrefix) to obtain the registry-issued
        PublisherId, then DescribeType with Type+TypeName+PublisherId to read
        the registry-authoritative default-version Arn.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PublicTypeArnResolverRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentAlias
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import re

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          # Public third-party extension ARN shape:
          # arn:<partition>:cloudformation:<region>::type/resource/
          #   <publisherId(6-40 alnum/hyphen)>/<TypeName>-<version>
          PUBLIC_ARN_PATTERN = re.compile(
              r'^arn:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+:cloudformation:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+::type/'
              r'resource/[0-9a-zA-Z-]{6,40}/[0-9a-zA-Z-]+$')


          def resolve_public_type_arn(cfn, type_name):
              # Step 1: enumerate public extensions with ListTypes. By-name
              # DescribeType cannot see public extensions this account has
              # never activated, and TypeSummaries entries carry no Arn
              # member - but they do carry the registry-issued PublisherId.
              # The type-name prefix is passed inside the Filters structure
              # (top-level ListTypes parameters are only Visibility,
              # ProvisioningType, DeprecatedStatus, Type, Filters,
              # MaxResults and NextToken). Filters.TypeNamePrefix is a
              # prefix filter, so the results are exact-matched below.
              matches = []
              paginator = cfn.get_paginator('list_types')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Type='RESOURCE',
                                             Visibility='PUBLIC',
                                             Filters={'TypeNamePrefix':
                                                      type_name}):
                  matches.extend(
                      summary for summary in page['TypeSummaries']
                      if summary.get('TypeName') == type_name)
              if not matches:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      'Public type %s not found in the CloudFormation '
                      'registry' % type_name)
              publisher_id = matches[0].get('PublisherId')
              if not publisher_id:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      'Registry summary for %s did not include a '
                      'PublisherId' % type_name)
              # Step 2: describe the public extension with Type + TypeName +
              # PublisherId (the documented form for public third-party
              # extensions; works for types this account has never
              # activated). The full DescribeTypeSummary response carries
              # the registry-authoritative default-version Arn along with
              # DefaultVersionId - no ARN reconstruction anywhere.
              response = cfn.describe_type(Type='RESOURCE',
                                           TypeName=type_name,
                                           PublisherId=publisher_id)
              arn = response.get('Arn')
              if not arn:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      'DescribeType for %s (publisher %s) did not include '
                      'an Arn' % (type_name, publisher_id))
              logger.info('Resolved %s via publisher %s (default version '
                          '%s) to %s', type_name, publisher_id,
                          response.get('DefaultVersionId'), arn)
              return arn


          def validate_arn(attribute_name, arn):
              if not arn:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      '%s: resolver returned an empty ARN' % attribute_name)
              if not PUBLIC_ARN_PATTERN.match(arn):
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      '%s: ARN %s does not match the public extension shape '
                      'type/resource/<publisherId>/<TypeName>-<version>'
                      % (attribute_name, arn))


          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  if request_type == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                       {}, 'public-type-arn-resolver')
                      return
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  cfn = boto3.client('cloudformation')
                  lookups = [
                      ('KubernetesResourceArn',
                       props['KubernetesResourceTypeName']),
                      ('KubernetesHelmArn',
                       props['KubernetesHelmTypeName']),
                      ('EksClusterArn', props['EksClusterTypeName']),
                  ]
                  data = {}
                  for attribute_name, type_name in lookups:
                      arn = resolve_public_type_arn(cfn, type_name)
                      validate_arn(attribute_name, arn)
                      data[attribute_name] = arn
                  # Sanity check: the three ARNs must be mutually distinct
                  # in their final (TypeName-version) segments.
                  final_segments = set(
                      arn.split('/type/resource/')[1].split('/', 1)[1]
                      for arn in data.values())
                  if len(final_segments) != len(lookups):
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          'Resolved ARNs are not mutually distinct in '
                          'their final segments: %s'
                          % sorted(final_segments))
                  logger.info('Resolved public type ARNs: %s', data)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   data, 'public-type-arn-resolver')
              except Exception as err:
                  logger.exception('PublicTypeArnResolver invocation failed')
                  # Real failure text goes in the reason argument so it is
                  # readable directly from the stack event.
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                                   {'error': str(err)},
                                   'public-type-arn-resolver',
                                   reason=str(err))

  PublicTypeArnResolver:
    Type: Custom::PublicTypeArnResolver
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PublicTypeArnResolverFunction.Arn
      KubernetesResourceTypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource
      KubernetesHelmTypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm
      EksClusterTypeName: AWSQS::EKS::Cluster

  ############################################################################
  # CloudFormation registry type activations (AWSQS Kubernetes types).
  # Public third-party extensions are activated here via the PublicTypeArn
  # input, which is mutually exclusive with Type/TypeName/PublisherId/
  # AutoUpdate/MajorVersion/VersionBump - none of those properties may be set
  # alongside PublicTypeArn (the ARN carries the type kind implicitly).
  # Each PublicTypeArn is resolved at deploy time by Custom::PublicTypeArnResolver
  # (see above); no registry ARN is hardcoded in this template. Each
  # activation DependsOn the resolver and keeps only the PublicTypeArn
  # contract properties: PublicTypeArn, ExecutionRoleArn, LoggingConfig.
  ############################################################################
  KubernetesResourceTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn: PublicTypeArnResolver
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !GetAtt PublicTypeArnResolver.KubernetesResourceArn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: !Ref KubernetesResourceLogGroup
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationLoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

  KubernetesHelmTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn: PublicTypeArnResolver
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !GetAtt PublicTypeArnResolver.KubernetesHelmArn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: !Ref KubernetesHelmLogGroup
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationLoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

  EksClusterTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn: PublicTypeArnResolver
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !GetAtt PublicTypeArnResolver.EksClusterArn
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: !Ref EksClusterLogGroup
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationLoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

Outputs:
