AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Comprehensive Amazon SQS test infrastructure: a FIFO queue without a DLQ, a FIFO
  queue with a DLQ and its DLQ, a standard queue with a DLQ (redrive maxReceiveCount 5)
  and its DLQ, a separate FIFO DLQ, and a customer managed KMS key that encrypts every
  queue. Includes a comprehensive set of CloudWatch alarms, all with alarm actions
  disabled.

Resources:

  # =====================================================================
  # KMS key and alias used to encrypt all SQS queues in this template
  # =====================================================================
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used to encrypt all SQS queues in this stack
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSQSAuthorizedPrincipalsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}"
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"

  QueueEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sqs-comprehensive-test-queues
      TargetKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey

  # =====================================================================
  # Standard queue with dead letter queue (maxReceiveCount 5) and its DLQ
  # =====================================================================
  StandardQueueDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq"
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue"
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      RedrivePolicy: !Sub '{"deadLetterTargetArn":"${StandardQueueDlq.Arn}","maxReceiveCount":5}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # =====================================================================
  # FIFO queue with dead letter queue and its DLQ
  # =====================================================================
  FifoQueueDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  FifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      RedrivePolicy: !Sub '{"deadLetterTargetArn":"${FifoQueueDlq.Arn}","maxReceiveCount":3}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # =====================================================================
  # FIFO queue without a dead letter queue
  # =====================================================================
  FifoQueueNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-no-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # =====================================================================
  # Separate FIFO DLQ (standalone FIFO queue for testing)
  # =====================================================================
  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo"
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # =====================================================================
  # CloudWatch alarms (all with actions disabled)
  # =====================================================================

  # --- Standard queue: sum of messages sent, threshold 1, breaching on missing data
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-messages-sent"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Standard queue - sum of NumberOfMessagesSent greater than 1. Treats missing
        data as breaching. Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  # --- FIFO queue with DLQ: average number of messages sent vs anomaly detection band
  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        FIFO queue with DLQ - average NumberOfMessagesSent outside the anomaly
        detection band. Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      Metrics:
        - Id: messages_sent_avg
          Label: FifoWithDlqAverageMessagesSent
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueue.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: anomaly_band
          Expression: "ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(messages_sent_avg)"
      ThresholdMetricId: anomaly_band
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # --- Sent message size, maximum, threshold 183500 bytes
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-sent-message-size"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Standard queue - maximum SentMessageSize greater than 183500 bytes.
        Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: missing

  SeparateFifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-queue-sent-message-size"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Separate FIFO queue - maximum SentMessageSize greater than 183500 bytes.
        Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # --- DLQs: sum of visible messages greater than zero
  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq-visible-messages"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Standard DLQ - sum of ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible greater than 0.
        Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueDlq.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fifo-dlq-visible-messages"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        FIFO DLQ - sum of ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible greater than 0.
        Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueDlq.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # --- Age of oldest message, maximum, threshold 15, missing data treated as missing
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Standard queue - maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage greater than 15.
        Missing data is treated as missing. Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: missing

  SeparateFifoQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-queue-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Separate FIFO queue - maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage greater than 15.
        Missing data is treated as missing. Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # --- Messages not visible, maximum (standard 108000, separate FIFO 18000)
  StandardQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-not-visible-messages"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Standard queue - maximum ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible greater than
        108000. Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 108000
      TreatMissingData: missing

  SeparateFifoQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-separate-fifo-queue-not-visible-messages"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Separate FIFO queue - maximum ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible greater
        than 18000. Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 18000
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # --- Standard DLQ: age of oldest message, maximum, threshold 90
  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Standard DLQ - maximum ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage greater than 90.
        Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueueDlq.QueueName
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 90
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # --- Synthetic always-OK alarm (not breaching on missing data)
  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-synthetic-always-ok"
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Synthetic always-OK alarm - the threshold can never be breached and missing
        data is treated as not breaching, so the alarm always evaluates to OK.
        Alarm actions are disabled.
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:

      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 999999999999
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the prerequisite resources and nine AWS Systems Manager Automation
  runbooks used for automated remediation of PCI DSS controls. Prerequisites
  include a CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group with a 1827-day retention
  period, a KMS customer master key with key rotation enabled and a key policy
  granting full KMS access to the account root, an SSM automation execution
  role attached to the IAMFullAccess and AdministratorAccess managed policies,
  and an IAM role for the CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration. All resource
  identifiers are exported for use by custom AWS Config conformance packs.

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group (1827-day retention)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: KMS customer master key (rotation enabled, root access)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  CloudTrailKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer master key used to encrypt CloudTrail trails remediated by the
        PCI DSS SSM Automation runbooks.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: GrantAccountRootFullKmsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: GrantAutomationRoleKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:EnableKeyRotation
              - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: GrantCloudTrailServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  CloudTrailKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/pci-remediation-${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailKmsKey

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: SSM automation execution role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the PCI DSS SSM Automation runbooks to remediate
        resources on behalf of AWS Config.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisite: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs delivery role and log policy
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by CloudTrail to write log events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageCloudTrailLogGroupsAndStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail*'
              - Sid: WriteCloudTrailLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail*:log-stream:*'

  CloudTrailLogsResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "AWSCloudTrailCreateLogStream",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": { "Service": "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com" },
              "Action": [ "logs:CreateLogStream" ],
              "Resource": [ "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail*" ]
            },
            {
              "Sid": "AWSCloudTrailPutLogEvents",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": { "Service": "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com" },
              "Action": [ "logs:PutLogEvents" ],
              "Resource": [ "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/cloudtrail*:log-stream:${AWS::AccountId}_CloudTrail_*" ]
            }
          ]
        }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 1: encrypt a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrate
  # it with CloudWatch Logs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ConfigureCloudTrailEncryptionDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-ConfigureCloudTrailEncryption
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Encrypts the specified CloudTrail trail with the specified KMS key and
          configures the trail to deliver log events to the specified CloudWatch
          Logs log group. Remediates PCI DSS requirements 10.3 and 10.5.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail to encrypt and integrate
              with CloudWatch Logs.
            minChars: 1
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The key ID, key ARN, or key alias of the KMS key used to encrypt
              the trail.
            minChars: 1
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which the trail
              delivers log events.
            minChars: 1
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to write log
              events to the CloudWatch Logs log group.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ConfigureTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatchDelivery
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KmsKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdatedTrail
                Selector: '$.Trail'
                Type: StringMap
          - name: StartTrailLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
        outputs:
          - ConfigureTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatchDelivery.UpdatedTrail

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 2: enable key rotation for a KMS key
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-EnableKmsKeyRotation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables automatic annual rotation of the specified KMS customer master
          key. Remediates PCI DSS requirement 3.6.4.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The key ID, key ARN, or key alias of the KMS key for which key
              rotation is enabled.
            minChars: 1
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'
          - name: VerifyKeyRotationStatus
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: DescribeKey
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: KeyRotationEnabled
                Selector: '$.KeyMetadata.KeyRotationEnabled'
                Type: Boolean
        outputs:
          - VerifyKeyRotationStatus.KeyRotationEnabled

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 3: integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ConfigureCloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-ConfigureCloudTrailCloudWatchLogs
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Configures the specified CloudTrail trail to deliver log events to the
          specified CloudWatch Logs log group. Remediates PCI DSS requirement
          10.5.4.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail to integrate with
              CloudWatch Logs.
            minChars: 1
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which the trail
              delivers log events.
            minChars: 1
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to write log
              events to the CloudWatch Logs log group.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ConfigureTrailCloudWatchDelivery
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdatedTrail
                Selector: '$.Trail'
                Type: StringMap
          - name: StartTrailLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
        outputs:
          - ConfigureTrailCloudWatchDelivery.UpdatedTrail

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 4: enforce a PCI DSS compliant IAM password policy
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-UpdateIamPasswordPolicy
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Updates the account IAM password policy to require a minimum password
          length of 14 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number and symbol
          characters, allows users to change their own passwords, enforces a
          hard expiry with a maximum password age of 90 days and prevents reuse
          of the last 24 passwords. Remediates PCI DSS requirement 8.3.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnforcePciDssPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
              HardExpiry: true
          - name: VerifyAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: GetAccountPasswordPolicy
            outputs:
              - Name: PasswordPolicy
                Selector: '$.PasswordPolicy'
                Type: StringMap
        outputs:
          - VerifyAccountPasswordPolicy.PasswordPolicy

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 5: enable log file validation, multi-region and CloudWatch
  # integration for a CloudTrail trail
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-EnableCloudTrailLogFileValidation
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables log file validation for the specified CloudTrail trail and
          ensures the trail is a multi-region trail delivering log events to the
          specified CloudWatch Logs log group. Remediates PCI DSS requirements
          10.5.2 and 10.5.4.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail for which log file
              validation is enabled.
            minChars: 1
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group to which the trail
              delivers log events.
            minChars: 1
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to write log
              events to the CloudWatch Logs log group.
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ConfigureTrailValidationAndCloudWatchDelivery
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: UpdatedTrail
                Selector: '$.Trail'
                Type: StringMap
          - name: StartTrailLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
        outputs:
          - ConfigureTrailValidationAndCloudWatchDelivery.UpdatedTrail

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 6: revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default
  # security group
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on the specified default
          security group. Remediates PCI DSS requirements 1.2.1 and 1.3.1.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ID of the default security group whose inbound and outbound
              rules are revoked.
            allowedPattern: '^sg-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllInboundAndOutboundRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: revoke_all_security_group_rules
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def revoke_all_security_group_rules(events, context):
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    if not response['SecurityGroups']:
                        raise Exception('Security group ' + group_id + ' was not found.')
                    security_group = response['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    ingress_rules = security_group.get('IpPermissions', [])
                    egress_rules = security_group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                    if ingress_rules:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=ingress_rules
                        )
                    if egress_rules:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id,
                            IpPermissions=egress_rules
                        )
                    return {
                        'IngressRulesRevoked': len(ingress_rules),
                        'EgressRulesRevoked': len(egress_rules)
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: IngressRulesRevoked
                Selector: '$.IngressRulesRevoked'
                Type: Integer
              - Name: EgressRulesRevoked
                Selector: '$.EgressRulesRevoked'
                Type: Integer
        outputs:
          - RevokeAllInboundAndOutboundRules.IngressRulesRevoked
          - RevokeAllInboundAndOutboundRules.EgressRulesRevoked

  ReleaseElasticIpAddressDocument:

    Properties:

      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Releases the unused Elastic IP address associated with the specified
          allocation ID. Remediates PCI DSS requirement 1.2.1 by removing unused
          public IP addresses from the cardholder data environment.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: The allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release.
            allowedPattern: '^eipalloc-[0-9a-fA-F]{8,17}$'
        mainSteps:
          - name: VerifyAddressIsNotAssociated
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 120
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: verify_address_is_not_associated
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def verify_address_is_not_associated(events, context):
                    allocation_id = events['AllocationId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=[allocation_id])
                    for address in response['Addresses']:
                        if 'AssociationId' in address or 'InstanceId' in address:
                            raise Exception(
                                'Elastic IP address '
                                + allocation_id
                                + ' is associated with an AWS resource and cannot be released.'
                            )
                    return {'IsUnused': True}
            outputs:
              - Name: IsUnused
                Selector: '$.IsUnused'
                Type: Boolean
          - name: ReleaseElasticIpAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
        outputs:
          - VerifyAddressIsNotAssociated.IsUnused

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Automation 9: remove plaintext AWS credentials from a CodeBuild project
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  RemoveCodeBuildPlaintextCredentialsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: PCIRemediation-RemoveCodeBuildPlaintextCredentials
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Updates the specified CodeBuild project to remove any environment
          variables named AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Remediates
          PCI DSS requirements 2.2.4 and 8.2.1.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that allows Automation to perform the
              actions on your behalf.
            default: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
            allowedPattern: '^arn:(aws[a-zA-Z-]*):iam::\d{12}:role/[\w+=,.@/-]+$'
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: The name of the CodeBuild project to remediate.
            minChars: 1
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemovePlaintextAwsCredentials
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: remove_plaintext_aws_credentials
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                RESTRICTED_VARIABLE_NAMES = ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')


                def remove_plaintext_aws_credentials(events, context):
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    response = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])
                    if not response.get('projects'):
                        raise Exception('CodeBuild project ' + project_name + ' was not found.')
                    environment = response['projects'][0]['environment']
                    original_variables = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    retained_variables = [
                        variable
                        for variable in original_variables
                        if variable.get('name') not in RESTRICTED_VARIABLE_NAMES
                    ]
                    removed_count = len(original_variables) - len(retained_variables)
                    if removed_count > 0:
                        environment['environmentVariables'] = retained_variables
                        codebuild.update_project(name=project_name, environment=environment)
                    return {'RemovedVariables': removed_count}
            outputs:
              - Name: RemovedVariables
                Selector: '$.RemovedVariables'
                Type: Integer
        outputs:
          - RemovePlaintextAwsCredentials.RemovedVariables

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Claude Desktop (CoWork) telemetry monitoring. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log
  group that receives CoWork events, a set of metric filters for both CoWork
  telemetry schemas (local agent mode and Claude Code for Desktop) that publish
  input tokens, output tokens, cache read tokens, cache creation tokens,
  estimated cost, and session turn counts into shared metric names, and a
  CloudWatch dashboard with a configurable name scoped to a configurable
  metrics region (default us-east-1).

Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CoWork telemetry CloudWatch dashboard.
    Default: Claude-CoWork-Telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,254}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Dashboard name must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, underscores, periods, and hyphens.
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS region from which the dashboard reads CloudWatch metrics and from which the dashboard console URL is generated.
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedValues:
      - af-south-1
      - ap-east-1
      - ap-northeast-1
      - ap-northeast-2
      - ap-northeast-3
      - ap-south-1
      - ap-south-2
      - ap-southeast-1
      - ap-southeast-2
      - ap-southeast-3
      - ap-southeast-4
      - ca-central-1
      - ca-west-1
      - eu-central-1
      - eu-central-2
      - eu-north-1
      - eu-south-1
      - eu-south-2
      - eu-west-1
      - eu-west-2
      - eu-west-3
      - il-central-1
      - me-central-1
      - me-south-1
      - sa-east-1
      - us-east-1
      - us-east-2
      - us-west-1
      - us-west-2
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid commercial AWS region.
  MetricsNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: Custom CloudWatch namespace that receives the CoWork telemetry metrics.
    Default: CoWork/Telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_/.-]{1,253}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Namespace must start with a letter or number and contain only letters, numbers, underscores, slashes, periods, and hyphens.
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CoWork telemetry events (one JSON event per line).
    Default: /cowork/desktop/telemetry
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_/.#-]{1,512}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Log group name must contain only letters, numbers, underscores, slashes, periods, and hash characters.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period, in days, for the CoWork telemetry log group.
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3653
      - 4383
      - 5475
      - 6940
      - 10531
      - 12053
      - 15019
      - 18277
      - 25568
      - 36159
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs retention period.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Dashboard
        Parameters:
          - DashboardName
          - MetricsRegion
          - MetricsNamespace
      - Label:
          default: Telemetry Log Group
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
          - LogRetentionInDays

Resources:
  CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Claude-CoWork-Telemetry
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # =====================================================================
  # Schema A - CoWork local agent mode events:
  # {"mode":"local_agent","user":"...","model":"...","sessionId":"...",
  #  "usage":{"inputTokens":N,"outputTokens":N,"cacheReadTokens":N,
  #  "cacheCreationTokens":N},"estimatedCostUSD":D,"turnCount":N}
  # =====================================================================

  LocalAgentTokensInputMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: TokensInput
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.usage.inputTokens'
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentTokensOutputMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: TokensOutput
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.usage.outputTokens'
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentTokensCacheReadMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: TokensCacheRead
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cacheReadTokens'
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentTokensCacheCreateMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: TokensCacheCreate
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cacheCreationTokens'
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentEstimatedCostMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.estimatedCostUSD'
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentTurnCountMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.mode = "local_agent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: TurnCount
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.turnCount'
          DefaultValue: 0

  # =====================================================================
  # Schema B - Claude Code for Desktop events:
  # {"source":"claude_code_desktop","principal":"...","modelId":"...",
  #  "conversationId":"...","tokens":{"input":N,"output":N,"cacheRead":N,
  #  "cacheCreate":N},"costUSD":D,"turns":N}
  # =====================================================================

  DesktopTokensInputMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: TokensInput
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricsNamespace
          MetricValue: '$.tokens.input'
          DefaultValue: 0

  DesktopTokensOutputMF:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.source = "claude_code_desktop" }'
      MetricTransformations:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS CDK bootstrap environment: versioned, KMS-encrypted,
  HTTPS-only S3 file-asset bucket; immutable scan-on-push ECR container-asset
  repository; KMS encryption key with a qualifier-based alias; CDK IAM roles
  (file publishing, image publishing, account lookup, deployment actions, and
  CloudFormation execution) with configurable trusted accounts and managed
  policy ARNs; and an SSM parameter tracking the bootstrap version. The
  Qualifier uniquely identifies all stack components per account and region.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Bootstrap configuration
        Parameters:
          - Qualifier
          - BootstrapVariant
      - Label:
          default: Trust configuration
        Parameters:
          - TrustedAccounts
          - CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
      - Label:
          default: Asset storage configuration
        Parameters:
          - FileAssetsBucketName
          - KmsKeyArn
          - PublicAccessBlockConfiguration

Parameters:
  BootstrapVariant:
    Type: String
    Default: CDK
    AllowedValues:
      - CDK
    Description: Identifies this stack as deployed by the AWS CDK bootstrap tooling.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of AWS account IDs allowed to assume the CDK deployment and asset-publishing roles in this environment.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
    Description: Comma-separated list of IAM managed policy ARNs attached to the CloudFormation execution role.

  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fd0
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 10
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$'
    Description: Short identifier that uniquely distinguishes this bootstrap stack and its resources from others in the same account and region.

  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the file-asset S3 bucket. Leave empty to let CloudFormation generate a unique bucket name.

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the file-asset bucket and the container-asset repository. Leave empty to create a new KMS key.

  PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable the S3 Public Access Block configuration on the file-asset bucket.

Conditions:
  HasTrustedAccounts:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ''
              - !Ref TrustedAccounts
          - ''
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Fn::Join:
              - ''
              - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
          - ''
  CreateNewKey:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref KmsKeyArn
      - ''
  HasCustomBucketName:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
          - ''
  UsePublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref PublicAccessBlockConfiguration
      - 'true'

Resources:
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CDK asset encryption key (qualifier: ${Qualifier})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: KeyRetract
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount:
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudformation:stack-id:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/CDKBootstrap/*'
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Fn::If:
              - HasTrustedAccounts
              - Sid: CrossAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  AWS:
                    Fn::Split:
                      - ','
                      - Fn::Join:
                          - ','
                          - !Ref TrustedAccounts
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for an ML workshop. Creates admin
  and end-user portfolios with products for a VPC with private subnets and
  endpoints, IAM/KMS/S3, AWS Data Exchange, infrastructure, an application, a
  SageMaker notebook and a third-party ML model, each constrained by a dedicated
  launch role. Product templates are staged into a stack-owned private
  KMS-encrypted S3 bucket before artifact creation, with per-key fallback
  synthesis when source objects are unavailable. Also creates lead and developer
  end-user roles with read/describe permissions, SSM MLWorkshop parameter and S3
  tagged-object access, associated as principals to the correct portfolios.

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Description: Source URL hosting the nested CloudFormation product templates.
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    AllowedPattern: '^https://\S+$'
    ConstraintDescription: RootS3URL must be a valid https:// URL.
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for portfolio, product and IAM role names.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,19}$'
    ConstraintDescription: EnvironmentPrefix must be 1-20 lowercase alphanumeric or hyphen characters.

Resources:
  TemplateStagingKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Key for staged Service Catalog product templates.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootDelegate
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SvcDecryptViaS3
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: [servicecatalog.amazonaws.com, cloudformation.amazonaws.com]
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  TemplateStagingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt TemplateStagingKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  TemplateStagingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TemplateStagingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SvcCatRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${TemplateStagingBucket.Arn}/servicecatalog-*.json'
          - Sid: AccountRootRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${TemplateStagingBucket.Arn}/servicecatalog-*.json'
          - Sid: TlsDeny
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TemplateStagingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TemplateStagingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  TemplateCopyLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-template-copy-role'
      Description: Execution role for the template staging Lambda.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: staging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Logs
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-template-copy:*'
              - Sid: SrcRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: DestWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject]
                Resource: !Sub '${TemplateStagingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: SrcKms
                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: KeyKms
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt, kms:Encrypt]
                Resource: !GetAtt TemplateStagingKey.Arn

  TemplateCopyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-template-copy'
      Description: Stages product templates into the staging bucket with fallback synthesis.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt TemplateCopyLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import re
          from urllib.parse import urlparse
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")

          FALLBACK = json.dumps({
              "AWSTemplateFormatVersion": "2010-09-09",
              "Description": "Placeholder template staged by the ML workshop environment stack.",
              "Resources": {
                  "Placeholder": {
                      "Type": "AWS::SSM::Parameter",
                      "Properties": {
                          "Name": "/MLWorkshop/placeholder",
                          "Type": "String",
                          "Value": "placeholder"
                      }
                  }
              }
          }).encode("utf-8")

          def parse(url):
              p = urlparse(url)
              h = p.netloc.lower()
              path = p.path.lstrip("/")
              m = re.match(r"^(.+)\.s3[.-](?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)?amazonaws\.com$", h)
              if m:
                  return m.group(1), path
              m = re.match(r"^s3[.-](?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)?amazonaws\.com$", h)
              if m:
                  parts = path.split("/", 1)
                  return parts[0], parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
              return None, None

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event.get("ResourceProperties", {})
              dest = props.get("DestinationBucketName", "template-staging-copy")
              try:
                  keys = [k.strip() for k in props["RequiredKeys"].split(",") if k.strip()]
                  results = {}
                  if event.get("RequestType") == "Delete":
                      for k in keys:
                          try:
                              s3.delete_object(Bucket=dest, Key=k)
                          except Exception as e:
                              print("Cleanup failed for %s: %s" % (k, e))
                  else:
                      sb, prefix = parse(props["SourceURL"])
                      if prefix:
                          prefix = prefix.rstrip("/") + "/"
                      for k in keys:
                          data = FALLBACK
                          status = "generated"
                          if sb:
                              try:
                                  resp = s3.get_object(Bucket=sb, Key=prefix + k)
                                  data = resp["Body"].read()
                                  status = "copied"
                              except Exception as e:
                                  print("Source read failed for %s (%s); synthesizing fallback" % (k, e))
                          s3.put_object(Bucket=dest, Key=k, Body=data, ContentType="application/json")
                          results[k] = status
                          print("Staged %s: %s" % (k, status))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, results, dest)
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Template staging failed: %s" % e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(e)}, dest)

  TemplateStagingCopy:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: TemplateStagingBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TemplateCopyFunction.Arn
      SourceURL: !Ref RootS3URL
      DestinationBucketName: !Ref TemplateStagingBucket
      RequiredKeys: 'servicecatalog-vpc.json,servicecatalog-iam-kms-s3.json,servicecatalog-data-exchange.json,servicecatalog-infrastructure.json,servicecatalog-application.json,servicecatalog-sagemaker-notebook.json,servicecatalog-third-party-model.json'

  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-admin-portfolio'
      ProviderName: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Description: !Sub 'Admin portfolio for the ${EnvironmentPrefix} ML workshop.'

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-portfolio'
      ProviderName: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Description: !Sub 'End-user portfolio for the ${EnvironmentPrefix} ML workshop.'

  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateStagingCopy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-vpc'
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: 1.0
          Description: Version 1.0
          Info:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) environment VPC for Staging or Production.
  Provisions environment-specific CIDR ranges, three public subnets (two in the
  first AZ for the presentation/load-balancer tier and one in a second AZ for
  compute), two private subnets in the first AZ (application and data tiers),
  an internet gateway, an egress-only internet gateway for IPv6, an optional
  NAT gateway with a dedicated Elastic IP, public and private network ACLs,
  an EC2 cluster placement group, and a DHCP options set with the environment
  domain name and the Amazon-provided DNS servers.
  Note: public subnets do not auto-assign IPv4 public addresses on launch;
  instances requiring public IPv4 (for example a bastion) must request it
  explicitly at instance/ENI level or via an Elastic IP. Public reachability is
  provided by the internet gateway routes for IPv4 and IPv6, and instances
  receive IPv6 addresses automatically on creation.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    Default: Staging
    AllowedValues:
      - Staging
      - Production
    Description: Environment to provision. Selects the VPC and subnet CIDR ranges and the DHCP domain name.

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: "Yes"
    AllowedValues:
      - "Yes"
      - "No"
    Description: Deploy a NAT gateway (with its own Elastic IP) for private subnet IPv4 egress. Set to No when a bastion host provides NAT.

  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: TCP and UDP port of the bastion VPN service permitted inbound on the public subnets.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentType
      - Label:
          default: Outbound connectivity
        Parameters:
          - DeployNatGateway
      - Label:
          default: Bastion access
        Parameters:
          - BastionVpnPort
    ParameterLabels:
      EnvironmentType:
        default: Environment type
      DeployNatGateway:
        default: Deploy NAT gateway
      BastionVpnPort:
        default: Bastion VPN port

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    Staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.0.0/22
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.4.0/22
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.1.8.0/22
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.12.0/22
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.16.0/22
      DomainName: staging.example.internal
    Production:
      VpcCidr: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.0.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.64.0/20
      DomainName: production.example.internal

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, "Yes"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  VpcDhcpOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-dhcp-options"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  VpcDhcpOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref VpcDhcpOptions

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-internet-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  VpcInternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-egress-only-internet-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Public subnets

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 0
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 5
          - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-az1-presentation-a"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Network
          Value: public
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 1
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 5
          - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-az1-presentation-b"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Network
          Value: public
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 2
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 5
          - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-az2-compute"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Network
          Value: public
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Private subnets

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 3
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 5
          - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-az1-application"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Network
          Value: private
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentType, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select
        - 4
        - !Cidr
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks
          - 5
          - 64
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-az1-data"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Key: Network
          Value: private
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Optional NAT gateway

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-nat-eip"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VpcInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-nat-gateway"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Routing

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-route-table"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-private-route-table"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PrivateRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: "::/0"
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Public network ACL

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentType}-public-network-acl"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType

  PublicNetworkAclEntryHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
