AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Provisions a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona with a
  persona-scoped Studio execution role and a dedicated per-user SageMaker execution
  role. Attaches the profile to an optional existing Studio domain (with its security
  groups and subnets), or creates a self-contained VPC, subnet, and
  public-internet-access SageMaker Studio domain when no domain ID is supplied.
  Outputs the ARN of the created user profile.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Existing SageMaker Studio domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - ExistingDomainId
          - ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
          - ExistingDomainSubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: MLOps engineer user profile
        Parameters:
          - MlopsUserProfileName

Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain to attach the user profile
      to. Leave empty to have this stack create a self-contained VPC, subnet, and
      public-internet-access SageMaker Studio domain.
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^d-[0-9a-zA-Z]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a SageMaker Studio domain ID such as d-abc123.
  ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Security group IDs associated with the existing domain. Provide together with
      ExistingDomainId; they are applied to the user profile user settings.
  ExistingDomainSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Subnet IDs of the VPC associated with the existing domain. Provide together
      with ExistingDomainId; recorded as the network context of the supplied domain.
  MlopsUserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 characters of letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer persona.

Conditions:
  CreateStudioDomain: !Equals
    - !Ref ExistingDomainId
    - ""
  UseExistingDomain: !Not
    - !Condition CreateStudioDomain
  ExistingDomainSgsProvided: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Join
          - ","
          - !Ref ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
        - ""

Resources:
  MlopsArtifactBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer managed key that encrypts SageMaker MLOps engineer artifacts stored
        in the dedicated S3 artifact bucket for this persona. Key access is delegated
        to the account root and governed through IAM role policies.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: sagemaker-artifact-encryption

  MlopsArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MlopsArtifactBucketKey.Arn
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: sagemaker-artifacts

  MlopsSageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Per-user SageMaker execution role that the MLOps engineer Studio role passes
        to SageMaker jobs, pipelines, and monitoring processing jobs.
      RoleName: mlops-engineer-sagemaker-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: per-user-sagemaker-execution
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MlopsJobExecutionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${MlopsArtifactBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketListAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MlopsArtifactBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsArtifactEncryptionAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MlopsArtifactBucketKey.Arn
              - Sid: SageMakerContainerImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SageMakerLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SageMakerLogStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*:log-stream:*"
              - Sid: SageMakerMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: "*"

  MlopsPersonaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        SageMaker Studio execution role scoped to the MLOps engineer persona
        responsibilities. Assumable only by the SageMaker service.
      RoleName: mlops-engineer-studio-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: mlops-engineer-studio-execution
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MlopsPersonaSageMakerAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassMlopsExecutionRoleToSageMaker
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MlopsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEqualsIfExists:
                    "iam:PassedToService": sagemaker.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ReadMlopsExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MlopsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
              - Sid: ManageSageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageModelMonitoringSchedules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlerts
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringAlert
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlertHistory
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageModelsAndModelRegistry
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ViewExperimentsTrialsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:Search
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: RunSageMakerJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageSageMakerEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: TagSageMakerResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: MlopsArtifactBucketObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${MlopsArtifactBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: MlopsArtifactBucketListAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MlopsArtifactBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsArtifactEncryptionAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MlopsArtifactBucketKey.Arn

  MlopsPersonaStudioAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MlopsPersonaStudioAppSpaceAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref MlopsPersonaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageOwnedStudioAppsAndSpaces
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
              - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
              - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn": !GetAtt MlopsStudioUserProfile.UserProfileArn
          - Sid: ViewStudioAppsAndSpaces
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeApp
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:ListApps
              - sagemaker:ListSpaces
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: StudioSelfServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt MlopsStudioUserProfile.UserProfileArn
          - Sid: ViewStudioDomain
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
            Resource:
              - !Sub
                - "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/${DomainId}"
                - DomainId: !If
                    - UseExistingDomain
                    - !Ref ExistingDomainId
                    - !GetAtt MlopsStudioDomain.DomainId

  MlopsStudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "mlops-studio-vpc-${AWS::StackName}"

  MlopsStudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "mlops-studio-igw-${AWS::StackName}"

  MlopsStudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MlopsStudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref MlopsStudioInternetGateway

  MlopsStudioSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MlopsStudioVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "mlops-studio-subnet-${AWS::StackName}"

  MlopsStudioPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MlopsStudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "mlops-studio-public-rt-${AWS::StackName}"

  MlopsStudioPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    DependsOn: MlopsStudioVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref MlopsStudioPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref MlopsStudioInternetGateway

  MlopsStudioSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref MlopsStudioSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref MlopsStudioPublicRouteTable

  MlopsStudioDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateStudioDomain
    Properties:
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      DomainName: !Sub "mlops-studio-${AWS::StackName}"
      VpcId: !Ref MlopsStudioVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref MlopsStudioSubnet
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MlopsPersonaExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

  MlopsStudioUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - UseExistingDomain
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
        - !GetAtt MlopsStudioDomain.DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref MlopsUserProfileName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MlopsPersonaExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - ExistingDomainSgsProvided
          - !Ref ExistingDomainSecurityGroupIds
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: mlops-engineer

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile.
    Value: !GetAtt MlopsStudioUserProfile.UserProfileArn
  UserProfileName:
    Description: Name of the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile.
    Value: !Ref MlopsStudioUserProfile
  SageMakerDomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Studio domain the user profile belongs to.
    Value: !If
      - UseExistingDomain
      - !Ref ExistingDomainId
      - !GetAtt MlopsStudioDomain.DomainId
  MlopsEngineerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the persona-scoped SageMaker Studio execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt MlopsPersonaExecutionRole.Arn
  MlopsSageMakerExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the per-user SageMaker execution role passed to SageMaker jobs.
    Value: !GetAtt MlopsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket holding SageMaker artifacts for the persona.
    Value: !Ref MlopsArtifactBucket
  ExistingDomainSubnetNetworkContext:
    Description: >-
      Subnet IDs supplied for the existing domain, recorded as its network context.
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - !Ref ExistingDomainSubnetIds

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Composite CloudWatch alarms monitoring the health of the cross-region failover
  Remittance application. Metric alarms target the existing Remittance API Gateway
  API, the existing GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the
  existing dbcluster1-instance1 RDS DB instance. Three OR-based composite alarms
  (API Gateway Health, Lambda Health and RDS Health) trip when any of their
  underlying metric alarms enters the ALARM state.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Existing API Gateway API
        Parameters:
          - RemittanceApiName
          - RemittanceApiStageName
      - Label:
          default: Existing Lambda Functions
        Parameters:
          - GetRemittancesFunctionName
          - CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      - Label:
          default: Existing RDS DB Instance
        Parameters:
          - RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier

Parameters:
  RemittanceApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance
    Description: Name of the existing Remittance API Gateway REST API.

  RemittanceApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Stage of the existing Remittance API Gateway REST API to monitor.

  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.

  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.

  RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: DBInstanceIdentifier of the existing remittance RDS DB instance.

Resources:

  # =========================================================================
  # API Gateway metric alarms (stage level)
  # =========================================================================

  RemittanceApi4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceApiName} API Gateway stage ${RemittanceApiStageName} 4XX error
        rate averaging above 0 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiStageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count

  RemittanceApi5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceApiName} API Gateway stage ${RemittanceApiStageName} 5XX error
        rate averaging above 1 over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiStageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count

  RemittanceApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceApiName} API Gateway stage ${RemittanceApiStageName} latency
        averaging at or above 10000 milliseconds over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiName
        - Name: Stage
          Value: !Ref RemittanceApiStageName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Milliseconds

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda metric alarms - GetRemittances
  # =========================================================================

  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${GetRemittancesFunctionName} Lambda function errors summing above 0 over
        60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${GetRemittancesFunctionName} Lambda function invocations summing above 2
        over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${GetRemittancesFunctionName} Lambda function duration averaging at or above
        10000 milliseconds over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Unit: Milliseconds

  # =========================================================================
  # Lambda metric alarms - CreateRemittance
  # =========================================================================

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Lambda function errors summing above 0 over
        60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Lambda function invocations summing above 2
        over 60 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Lambda function duration averaging at or
        above 10000 milliseconds over 900 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Unit: Milliseconds

  # =========================================================================
  # RDS metric alarms - dbcluster1-instance1
  # =========================================================================

  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} CPU utilization averaging at or above
        70 percent over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Percent

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} database connections averaging at or above
        100 over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Count

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} deadlocks averaging at or above 10 over
        300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Count

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} network transmit throughput averaging at
        or above 10485760 bytes per second over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Bytes/Second

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} network receive throughput averaging at
        or above 10485760 bytes per second over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Bytes/Second

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} queries averaging at or above 100 over
        300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Count

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} disk queue depth averaging at or above 50
        over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Count

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} read latency averaging at or above
        0.1 seconds over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Seconds

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} write latency averaging at or above
        0.1 seconds over 300 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Seconds

  # =========================================================================
  # Composite alarms (OR-based rules - any triggered child trips the composite)
  # =========================================================================

  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Composite health of the ${RemittanceApiName} API Gateway. Trips when any of
        the 4XX error, 5XX error or latency metric alarms is in the ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - 'ALARM("${FourXX}") OR ALARM("${FiveXX}") OR ALARM("${Latency}")'
        - FourXX: !GetAtt RemittanceApi4XXErrorAlarm.Arn
          FiveXX: !GetAtt RemittanceApi5XXErrorAlarm.Arn
          Latency: !GetAtt RemittanceApiLatencyAlarm.Arn

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    DependsOn:
      - GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm
      - CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Composite health of the ${GetRemittancesFunctionName} and
        ${CreateRemittanceFunctionName} Lambda functions. Trips when any of the
        errors or duration metric alarms is in the ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - >-
          ALARM("${GetErrors}") OR ALARM("${CreateErrors}")
          OR ALARM("${GetDuration}") OR ALARM("${CreateDuration}")
        - GetErrors: !GetAtt GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm.Arn
          CreateErrors: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm.Arn
          GetDuration: !GetAtt GetRemittancesDurationAlarm.Arn
          CreateDuration: !GetAtt CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm.Arn

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        Composite health of the ${RemittanceDbInstanceIdentifier} RDS DB instance.
        Trips when any of the CPU, database connections, deadlocks, network
        throughput, queries, disk queue depth or read/write latency metric alarms
        is in the ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub
        - >-
          ALARM("${Cpu}") OR ALARM("${Connections}") OR ALARM("${Deadlocks}")
          OR ALARM("${NetTransmit}") OR ALARM("${NetReceive}") OR ALARM("${Queries}")
          OR ALARM("${DiskQueueDepth}") OR ALARM("${ReadLatency}") OR ALARM("${WriteLatency}")
        - Cpu: !GetAtt RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm.Arn
          Connections: !GetAtt RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm.Arn
          Deadlocks: !GetAtt RdsDeadlocksAlarm.Arn
          NetTransmit: !GetAtt RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm.Arn
          NetReceive: !GetAtt RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm.Arn
          Queries: !GetAtt RdsQueriesAlarm.Arn
          DiskQueueDepth: !GetAtt RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm.Arn
          ReadLatency: !GetAtt RdsReadLatencyAlarm.Arn
          WriteLatency: !GetAtt RdsWriteLatencyAlarm.Arn

Outputs:
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin suite monitoring and data extraction pipeline: seven AWS Glue jobs
  (five Python shell jobs on Glue 3.0 with Python 3.9 and two ETL jobs on Glue 5.0 with
  G.1X workers), each scheduled every 3 hours by its own trigger, five JSON CloudWatch
  metric streams feeding dedicated DirectPut Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams,
  all writing into a private, CMK-encrypted S3 bucket named admin-suite-<account-id>
  and governed by a single shared IAM role.

Resources:
  AdminSuiteDataBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed CMK encrypting the admin-suite S3 bucket (Glue outputs, scripts and metric stream data).
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowAdminSuiteMonitoringRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AdminSuiteMonitoringRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: admin-suite
        - Key: Component
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteDataBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: admin-suite
        - Key: Component
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  AdminSuiteMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Single shared pipeline role assumable by Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose and the CloudWatch metric stream service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: admin-suite
        - Key: Component
          Value: quicksight-admin-suite

  AdminSuiteMonitoringRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: admin-suite-monitoring-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref AdminSuiteMonitoringRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: QuickSightReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - quicksight:List*
              - quicksight:Describe*
              - quicksight:Get*
              - quicksight:Search*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: GlueAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - glue:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: S3BucketAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn
          - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource: !Sub "${AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn}/*"
          - Sid: KmsBucketKeyUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteDataBucketKey.Arn
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:log-stream:*"
          - Sid: FirehoseAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
              - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
              - firehose:ListTagsForDeliveryStream
              - firehose:PutRecord
              - firehose:PutRecordBatch
              - firehose:TagDeliveryStream
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: IamPassRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt AdminSuiteMonitoringRole.Arn
          - Sid: IamReadAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetRolePolicy
              - iam:ListRolePolicies
              - iam:ListRoles
            Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteAssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: AdminSuiteMonitoringRolePolicy
    Properties:

      Description: Collects QuickSight asset access details.

      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${AdminSuiteDataBucket}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--region": !Ref "AWS::Region"
        "--account_id": !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
        "--output_bucket": !Ref AdminSuiteDataBucket
        "--output_path": !Sub "s3://${AdminSuiteDataBucket}/output/asset-access/"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
      Tags:
        Application: admin-suite
        Component: quicksight-admin-suite

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap IAM identities and permission policies for an
  Amazon EKS based cluster. Creates EC2-assumable control-plane, nodes, and controllers
  roles (the controllers role is also assumable by EKS pods), a dedicated EKS control-plane
  role with the AWS managed AmazonEKSClusterPolicy, instance profiles for the control-plane,
  nodes, and controllers roles, customer managed policies for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud
  provider, node registration/image pull, Cluster API controller infrastructure management,
  EKS cluster lifecycle management, and a standalone managed policy granting read-only
  console visibility into EKS clusters, node groups, and workloads for human users or groups.

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 instances acting as the Kubernetes control plane for the CAPA-managed EKS cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-capa-control-plane"
        - Key: cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: control-plane

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 instances running Kubernetes worker nodes for the CAPA-managed EKS cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-capa-nodes"
        - Key: cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: nodes

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 instances and by EKS pods hosting the Cluster API controllers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-capa-controllers"
        - Key: cluster-api-provider-aws/role
          Value: controllers

  EKSClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the Amazon EKS service to create and operate the cluster.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-eks-cluster"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  ControlPlaneCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, and KMS permissions required by the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider running on the control plane.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudProviderDescribe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CloudProviderEbsAndSecurityGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CloudProviderLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyRule
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetWebAcl

          - Sid: CloudProviderKms

              - kms:ReEncrypt*

          - Sid: CloudProviderAutoScaling

            Action:

              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"

        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: EC2, ECR, Secrets Manager, and SSM permissions required by cluster nodes to register with the cluster and pull container images.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Provisions an AWS Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job and its dedicated IAM service role for
  converting Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files. The IAM role trusts
  glue.amazonaws.com, attaches the AWSGlueServiceRole managed policy, and adds
  inline policies for full CloudWatch logging access and scoped S3 access to the
  raw GIS, script, and knowledge base buckets.

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue Spark ETL job.

  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    Description: S3 path to the Glue ETL Python script.

  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    Description: Name of the IAM service role assumed by the Glue job.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Glue ETL Job Configuration
        Parameters:
          - GlueJobName
          - GlueScriptLocation
          - GlueServiceRoleName

Resources:
  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      Description: Service role assumed by the Shapefile-to-GeoJSON Glue ETL job.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCloudWatchLoggingAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: FullCloudWatchLoggingAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:*
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: GlueScopedS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadRawGisAndScriptBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-raw-gis/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts/*
              - Sid: ReadWriteKnowledgeBase
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base/*
              - Sid: WriteGlueJobWorkspacePrefixes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts/spark-logs/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/*

  ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Description: Glue 4.0 Spark ETL job that converts Shapefiles into individual GeoJSON files.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: "4.0"
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: "3"
        ScriptLocation: !Ref GlueScriptLocation
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 2880
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-spark-ui": "true"
        "--spark-event-logs-path": "s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/spark-logs/"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
        "--TempDir": "s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/"
        "--additional-python-modules": "geopandas0.14.1,shapely2.0.2,pyproj3.6.1,fiona1.9.5"

Outputs:
  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the Shapefile-to-GeoJSON Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref ShapefileToGeoJsonGlueJob

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role assumed by the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn

  GlueScriptUploadCommand:
    Description: AWS CLI command to upload the ETL script to the configured S3 script location.
    Value: !Sub "aws s3 cp shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py ${GlueScriptLocation}"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Deploys a scheduled, account-level Amazon S3 Block Public Access enforcement
  solution. An enabled EventBridge daily schedule starts an SSM Automation
  runbook (schema version 0.3) that calls the S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock
  API to enable BlockPublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, IgnorePublicAcls, and
  RestrictPublicBuckets for the local account.

Resources:

  S3PublicAccessBlockAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by AWS Systems Manager Automation to enforce account-level S3 Block Public Access via the S3 Control API.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountLevelPublicAccessBlock
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EnforceS3AccountPublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement

  EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by Amazon EventBridge to describe and start executions of the S3 Block Public Access enforcement runbook.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartS3PublicAccessBlockAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeEnforcementRunbook
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook}'
              - Sid: StartEnforcementRunbook
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook}'
              - Sid: PassRunbookAssumeRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt S3PublicAccessBlockAutomationRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement

  S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: enforce-account-level-s3-public-access-block
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables all four account-level Amazon S3 Block Public Access settings for
          the local account using the S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API, then
          reads the resulting configuration back to confirm enforcement.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              The ARN of the IAM role that Automation assumes to perform the
              S3 Control API calls.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
          - name: VerifyAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: GetPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}'
            outputs:
              - Name: BlockPublicAcls
                Selector: '$.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicAcls'
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: BlockPublicPolicy
                Selector: '$.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.BlockPublicPolicy'
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: IgnorePublicAcls
                Selector: '$.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.IgnorePublicAcls'
                Type: Boolean
              - Name: RestrictPublicBuckets
                Selector: '$.PublicAccessBlockConfiguration.RestrictPublicBuckets'
                Type: Boolean
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement

  DailyS3PublicAccessBlockRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Daily schedule that starts the SSM Automation runbook enforcing
        account-level S3 Block Public Access.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub '{"AutomationAssumeRole": ["${S3PublicAccessBlockAutomationRole.Arn}"]}'
          RunCommandParameters:
            RunCommandTargets:
              - Key: InstanceIds
                Values:
                  - '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Solution
          Value: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockEnforcement

Outputs:
  RunbookName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation runbook.
    Value: !Ref S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook
  RunbookArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Automation runbook.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3PublicAccessBlockRunbook}'
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by SSM Automation.
    Value: !GetAtt S3PublicAccessBlockAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by EventBridge to start the runbook.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
  ScheduleRuleName:
    Description: Name of the daily EventBridge schedule rule.
    Value: !Ref DailyS3PublicAccessBlockRule
  ScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily EventBridge schedule rule.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyS3PublicAccessBlockRule.Arn
