  policy grants key usage to the Service Catalog launch roles, the dms-vpc-role
  service role and a DMS replication subnet group spanning both subnets, an
  ElastiCache subnet group and cache security group, a SageMaker execution role,
  and one launch role per product type covering application load balancers,
  listeners, target groups, Auto Scaling, DMS endpoints, DMS instances,
  DynamoDB, EBS, EFS, ElastiCache, Elasticsearch, FSx, Kinesis, SNS, SQS,
  SageMaker and S3. Deploy with CAPABILITY_IAM and CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Resources:

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-preventive-controls-vpc

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ["0", !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-preventive-controls-subnet-1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ["1", !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-preventive-controls-subnet-2

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog preventive controls test resources
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-preventive-controls-resources-sg

  CacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Cache security group for ElastiCache clusters in the test environment
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow Redis access from the test resource security group
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 11211
          ToPort: 11211
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow Memcached access from the test resource security group
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-preventive-controls-cache-sg

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key used by Service Catalog products provisioned in the test environment
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: sc-test-preventive-controls-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleAlb.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleListener.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleTargetGroup.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleAutoScaling.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDmsEndpoint.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDmsInstance.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDynamoDb.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEbs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEfs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElastiCache.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleElasticsearch.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleFsx.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleKinesis.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSns.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSqs.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleSageMaker.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleS3.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:RetireGrant
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerExecutionRoleToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:RetireGrant
            Resource: "*"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sc-test-preventive-controls-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      Description: DMS service role required before a replication subnet group can be created
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole"

  DmsReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DmsVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupIdentifier: sc-test-dms-subnet-group
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: DMS replication subnet group spanning the Service Catalog preventive controls test subnets
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-dms-subnet-group

  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      CacheSubnetGroupName: sc-test-elasticache-subnet-group
      Description: ElastiCache subnet group spanning the Service Catalog preventive controls test subnets
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sc-test-elasticache-subnet-group

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-sagemaker-execution-role
      Description: Execution role assumed by SageMaker resources provisioned in the test environment
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-sagemaker-execution-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AccessSageMakerS3Buckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*"
              - Sid: AccessSageMakerS3Objects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*/*"
              - Sid: PublishLogsAndMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: PullContainerImages
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: UseTestEnvironmentKmsKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:ListGrants
                  - kms:RevokeGrant
                  - kms:RetireGrant
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*"

  LaunchRoleAlb:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-alb
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for application load balancer products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-alb-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateLoadBalancersInTestSubnets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  ForAllValues:ArnEquals:
                    elasticloadbalancing:Subnets:
                      - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${Subnet1}"
                      - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${Subnet2}"
                    elasticloadbalancing:SecurityGroups:
                      - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${TestSecurityGroup}"
              - Sid: ManageAndDescribeLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:SetIpAddressType
                  - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeTestNetwork
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleListener:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-listener
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for listener products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-listener-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAndDescribeListeners
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddListenerCertificates
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveListenerCertificates
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeTestNetwork
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-target-group
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for target group products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-target-group-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAndDescribeTargetGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeTestNetwork
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleAutoScaling:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-autoscaling
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Auto Scaling products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-autoscaling-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageAutoScalingResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
                  - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
                  - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
                  - autoscaling:DeleteTags
                  - autoscaling:AttachLoadBalancers
                  - autoscaling:DetachLoadBalancers
                  - autoscaling:AttachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
                  - autoscaling:DetachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
                  - autoscaling:PutScalingPolicy
                  - autoscaling:DeletePolicy
                  - autoscaling:ExecutePolicy
                  - autoscaling:EnableMetricsCollection
                  - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
                  - autoscaling:SetInstanceProtection
                  - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
                  - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
                  - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeEc2ResourcesForAutoScaling
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypeOfferings
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CreateAutoScalingServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling"

  LaunchRoleDmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-dms-endpoint
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DMS endpoint products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-dms-endpoint-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageDmsEndpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dms:CreateEndpoint
                  - dms:ModifyEndpoint
                  - dms:DeleteEndpoint
                  - dms:DescribeEndpoints
                  - dms:DescribeEndpointTypes
                  - dms:DescribeEndpointSettings
                  - dms:TestConnection
                  - dms:DeleteConnection
                  - dms:DescribeSchemas
                  - dms:DescribeCertificates
                  - dms:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - dms:AddTagsToResource
                  - dms:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - dms:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleDmsInstance:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-dms-instance
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DMS replication instance products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-dms-instance-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageDmsReplicationInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dms:CreateReplicationInstance
                  - dms:ModifyReplicationInstance
                  - dms:DeleteReplicationInstance
                  - dms:RebootReplicationInstance
                  - dms:DescribeReplicationInstances
                  - dms:DescribeOrderableReplicationInstances
                  - dms:DescribeReplicationSubnetGroups
                  - dms:DescribeReplicationInstanceTaskLogs
                  - dms:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - dms:DescribeCertificates
                  - dms:AddTagsToResource
                  - dms:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - dms:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleDynamoDb:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-dynamodb
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for DynamoDB table products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-dynamodb-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageDynamoDbTables
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:CreateTable
                  - dynamodb:DeleteTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTimeToLive
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTimeToLive
                  - dynamodb:UpdateContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                  - dynamodb:DeleteBackup
                  - dynamodb:DescribeBackup
                  - dynamodb:TagResource
                  - dynamodb:UntagResource
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*"
              - Sid: DescribeDynamoDbAccountLimits
                Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:DescribeLimits
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleEbs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-ebs
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for EBS volume products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-ebs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateEbsVolumesAndSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateVolume
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageEbsVolumesAndSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteVolume
                  - ec2:ModifyVolume
                  - ec2:EnableVolumeIO
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:ResetSnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumeAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumeStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleEfs:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-efs
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for EFS file system products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-efs-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageEfsResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems
                  - elasticfilesystem:UpdateFileSystem
                  - elasticfilesystem:PutFileSystemPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteFileSystemPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystemPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeLifecycleConfiguration
                  - elasticfilesystem:PutBackupPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeBackupPolicy
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateMountTarget
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteMountTarget
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargetSecurityGroups
                  - elasticfilesystem:ModifyMountTargetSecurityGroups
                  - elasticfilesystem:CreateAccessPoint
                  - elasticfilesystem:DeleteAccessPoint
                  - elasticfilesystem:DescribeAccessPoints
                  - elasticfilesystem:TagResource
                  - elasticfilesystem:UntagResource
                  - elasticfilesystem:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleElastiCache:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-elasticache
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for ElastiCache cluster products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-elasticache-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageElastiCacheResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticache:CreateCacheCluster
                  - elasticache:DeleteCacheCluster
                  - elasticache:ModifyCacheCluster
                  - elasticache:RebootCacheCluster
                  - elasticache:CreateReplicationGroup
                  - elasticache:DeleteReplicationGroup
                  - elasticache:ModifyReplicationGroup
                  - elasticache:TestFailover
                  - elasticache:CreateSnapshot
                  - elasticache:DeleteSnapshot
                  - elasticache:Describe*
                  - elasticache:AddTagsToResource
                  - elasticache:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleElasticsearch:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-elasticsearch
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Elasticsearch domain products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-elasticsearch-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageElasticsearchDomains
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - es:CreateDomain
                  - es:DeleteDomain
                  - es:UpdateDomainConfig
                  - es:DescribeDomain
                  - es:DescribeDomains
                  - es:DescribeDomainConfig
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:es:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:domain/*"
              - Sid: DescribeAndTagElasticsearchResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - es:ListDomainNames
                  - es:ListElasticsearchInstanceTypes
                  - es:ListElasticsearchVersions
                  - es:DescribeElasticsearchInstanceTypeLimits
                  - es:AddTags
                  - es:RemoveTags
                  - es:ListTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CreateElasticsearchServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/opensearchservice.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonOpenSearchService"

  LaunchRoleFsx:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-fsx
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for FSx file system products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-fsx-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateAndDescribeFsxResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fsx:CreateFileSystem
                  - fsx:CreateFileSystemFromBackup
                  - fsx:CreateBackup
                  - fsx:CopyBackup
                  - fsx:DescribeFileSystems
                  - fsx:DescribeBackups
                  - fsx:TagResource
                  - fsx:UntagResource
                  - fsx:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DeleteAndUpdateFsxResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fsx:DeleteFileSystem
                  - fsx:UpdateFileSystem
                  - fsx:DeleteBackup
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:fsx:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:file-system/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:fsx:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:backup/*"
              - Sid: CreateFsxServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/fsx.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonFSx"

  LaunchRoleKinesis:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-kinesis
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Kinesis stream products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sc-test-launch-kinesis-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageKinesisStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:CreateStream
                  - kinesis:DeleteStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:UpdateShardCount
                  - kinesis:IncreaseStreamRetentionPeriod
                  - kinesis:DecreaseStreamRetentionPeriod
                  - kinesis:StartStreamEncryption
                  - kinesis:StopStreamEncryption
                  - kinesis:EnableEnhancedMonitoring
                  - kinesis:DisableEnhancedMonitoring
                  - kinesis:AddTagsToStream
                  - kinesis:ListTagsForStream
                  - kinesis:RemoveTagsFromStream
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/*"
              - Sid: DescribeKinesisAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                  - kinesis:DescribeLimits
                Resource: "*"

  LaunchRoleSns:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sc-test-launch-sns
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for SNS topic products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform with a customer managed KMS key, DynamoDB stores, S3 assets, a Step Functions and Bedrock pipeline, a Cognito protected HTTP API, callbacks, optional semantic search, and monitoring.

Parameters:
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9.:_-]{1,128}$'
  BedrockEmbeddingModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9.:_-]{1,128}$'
  NotificationEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-team@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
  SmsSenderId:
    Type: String
    Default: CampAIgn
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,11}$'
  SmsOriginationNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: "+15550000000"
    AllowedPattern: '^\+?[0-9]{8,15}$'
  DeliveryCallbackToken:
    Type: String
    Default: change-me-provider-callback-token
    NoEcho: true
  DailyRateLimitDefault:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000
  MaxSegmentSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 500
  DeploySemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
  SemanticSearchCollectionName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-campaign-vectors
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,20}$'

Conditions:
  CreateSemanticSearch: !Equals [!Ref DeploySemanticSearch, "true"]

Resources:
  CampaignDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy: !Sub |
        {"Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [
          {"Sid": "RootAccess", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"}, "Action": "kms:*", "Resource": "*"},
          {"Sid": "DynamoDBS3", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"Service": ["dynamodb.amazonaws.com", "s3.amazonaws.com"]}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncrypt*", "kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:DescribeKey", "kms:CreateGrant"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "${AWS::AccountId}", "kms:ViaService": ["dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com", "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"]}}},
          {"Sid": "SnsService", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"Service": "sns.amazonaws.com"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncrypt*", "kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:DescribeKey", "kms:CreateGrant"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "${AWS::AccountId}", "kms:ViaService": "sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"}}},
          {"Sid": "CloudWatchAlarms", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"Service": "cloudwatch.amazonaws.com"}, "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "${AWS::AccountId}"}, "ArnLike": {"aws:SourceArn": "arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:${AWS::StackName}-campaign-executions-failed"}}},
          {"Sid": "OpenSearchServerless", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"Service": "aoss.amazonaws.com"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncrypt*", "kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:DescribeKey", "kms:CreateGrant"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"StringLike": {"kms:EncryptionContext:aws:oss:collectionArn": "arn:aws:aoss:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:collection/*"}}},
          {"Sid": "CloudWatchLogs", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"Service": "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncrypt*", "kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource": "*", "Condition": {"ArnEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn": ["arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/*", "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/http-api/*"]}}}
        ]}

  CampaignDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-campaign-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignDataKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-customer-profiles'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: segment, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: segment-index
          KeySchema:
            - {AttributeName: segment, KeyType: HASH}
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-channel-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: channel, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: channel, KeyType: HASH}
        - {AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: RANGE}
      TimeToLiveSpecification: {AttributeName: expiresAt, Enabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}

  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-delivery-tracking'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: campaignId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: deliveryId, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: campaignId, KeyType: HASH}
        - {AttributeName: deliveryId, KeyType: RANGE}
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: deliveryId-index
          KeySchema:
            - {AttributeName: deliveryId, KeyType: HASH}
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      TimeToLiveSpecification: {AttributeName: expiresAt, Enabled: true}
      SSESpecification: {SSEEnabled: true, SSEType: KMS, KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: {SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms, KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn}
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload: {DaysAfterInitiation: 7}

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-campaign-alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
      Subscription:
        - {Endpoint: !Ref 'NotificationEmailAddress', Protocol: email}

  OrchestrationLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-orchestrator'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  HttpApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/http-api/${AWS::StackName}-access'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  PipelineFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition: {StringEquals: {'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'}}
      ManagedPolicyArns: [arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole, arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess]
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipelineData
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DDB
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:BatchGetItem, dynamodb:BatchWriteItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:DescribeTable]
                Resource: [!GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn, !Sub '${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*', !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn, !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn, !Sub '${DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn}/index/*']
              - Sid: S3Objects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:AbortMultipartUpload]
                Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: S3Bucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:ListBucket, s3:GetBucketLocation]
                Resource: !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:ReEncrypt*, kms:GenerateDataKey*, kms:DescribeKey]
                Resource: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
              - Sid: Bedrock
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [bedrock:InvokeModel, bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream]
                Resource: [!Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}', !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::inference-profile/${BedrockModelId}']
              - Sid: SnsSms
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: Ses
                Effect: Allow
                Action: [ses:SendEmail, ses:SendRawEmail]
                Resource: "*"
                Condition: {StringEquals: {ses:FromAddress: !Ref 'NotificationEmailAddress'}}

  PipelineFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures: [arm64]
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 300
      TracingConfig: {Mode: Active}
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          RESULTS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
          NOTIFICATION_EMAIL: !Ref NotificationEmailAddress
          SMS_SENDER_ID: !Ref SmsSenderId
          SMS_ORIGINATION_NUMBER: !Ref SmsOriginationNumber
          DAILY_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT: !Ref DailyRateLimitDefault
          MAX_SEGMENT_SIZE: !Ref MaxSegmentSize
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime, json, os, re, time, uuid
          import boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID = os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"]
          PROFILES_TABLE = os.environ["PROFILES_TABLE"]
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE = os.environ["RATE_LIMITS_TABLE"]
          TRACKING_TABLE = os.environ["TRACKING_TABLE"]
          RESULTS_BUCKET = os.environ["RESULTS_BUCKET"]
          NOTIFICATION_EMAIL = os.environ["NOTIFICATION_EMAIL"]
          SMS_SENDER_ID = os.environ["SMS_SENDER_ID"]
          SMS_ORIGINATION_NUMBER = os.environ["SMS_ORIGINATION_NUMBER"]
          DAILY_LIMIT_DEFAULT = int(os.environ["DAILY_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT"])
          MAX_SEGMENT_SIZE = int(os.environ.get("MAX_SEGMENT_SIZE", "100"))
          VALID_CHANNELS = ("email", "sms", "push")
          PLANNER = 'You are a marketing campaign planner. Convert the instruction into JSON with keys: objective, audience, tone, channels (only "email","sms","push"). Respond with JSON only.'
          WRITER = "You write concise, compliant marketing copy. Respond with JSON only."
          BLOCKED_TERMS = "free money,guaranteed winner,risk free,crypto giveaway,urgent wire transfer".split(",")
          _email = re.compile(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+")
          _phone = re.compile(r"(\+?\d[\d\s().-]{8,}\d)")
          _ddb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          _br = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          _ses = boto3.client("sesv2")
          _sns = boto3.client("sns")
          _s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          _profiles = _ddb.Table(PROFILES_TABLE)
          _limits = _ddb.Table(RATE_LIMITS_TABLE)
          _tracking = _ddb.Table(TRACKING_TABLE)
          def _today():
            return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
          def _iso():
            return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
          def _invoke(system, prompt, max_tokens):
            body = {"anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31", "max_tokens": max_tokens, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]}
            if system:
              body["system"] = system
            payload = json.loads(_br.invoke_model(modelId=BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, body=json.dumps(body))["body"].read())
            return "".join(part.get("text", "") for part in payload.get("content", []))
          def _json(text):
            start, end = text.find("{"), text.rfind("}") + 1
            if start < 0 or end <= start:
              raise ValueError("no JSON in model response")
            return json.loads(text[start:end])
          def parse_step(s):
            instruction = str(s.get("instruction", "")).strip()[:4000]
            if not instruction:
              raise ValueError("instruction is required")
            try:
              parsed = _json(_invoke(PLANNER, "Instruction: " + instruction, 600))
            except Exception as e:
              print("instruction parsing failed: %s" % e)
              parsed = {}
            channels = [c for c in parsed.get("channels", []) if c in VALID_CHANNELS][:3]
            s["campaignSpec"] = {"objective": str(parsed.get("objective", instruction))[:280], "audience": str(parsed.get("audience", "all customers"))[:200], "tone": str(parsed.get("tone", "friendly"))[:80], "channels": channels or ["email"]}
            try:
              copy = _json(_invoke(WRITER, "Write core campaign copy. Return JSON with keys subject and body. Brief: " + json.dumps(s["campaignSpec"]), 500))
              s["baseContent"] = {"subject": str(copy.get("subject", ""))[:150], "body": str(copy.get("body", ""))[:1200]}
            except Exception as e:
              print("base copy generation failed: %s" % e)
              s["baseContent"] = {"subject": "A message from our team", "body": "Hello! " + s["campaignSpec"]["objective"]}
            return s
          def _matches(profile, audience):
            audience = (audience or "").lower()
            if audience in ("", "all customers", "everyone", "all"):
              return True
            hay = " ".join(str(profile.get(k, "")) for k in ("segment", "region", "tier", "interests", "notes")).lower()
            words = [w for w in audience.replace(",", " ").split() if len(w) > 2]
            return not words or any(w in hay for w in words)
          def segment_step(s):
            audience = s.get("campaignSpec", {}).get("audience", "all customers")
            customers, last = [], None
            while len(customers) < MAX_SEGMENT_SIZE:
              kwargs = {"FilterExpression": Attr("active").eq(True), "Limit": 50}
              if last:
                kwargs["ExclusiveStartKey"] = last
              page = _profiles.scan(**kwargs)
              for p in page.get("Items", []):
                if _matches(p, audience):
                  customers.append({"customerId": p.get("customerId", ""), "displayName": p.get("displayName", "customer"), "email": p.get("email", ""), "phone": p.get("phone", ""), "preferredChannel": p.get("preferredChannel", "email")})
                if len(customers) >= MAX_SEGMENT_SIZE:
                  break
              last = page.get("LastEvaluatedKey")
              if not last:
                break
            s["customers"] = customers
            s["customerCount"] = len(customers)
            return s
          def _available(channel, customer_id):
            item = _limits.get_item(Key={"channel": channel, "customerId": customer_id}).get("Item") or {}
            sent = int(item.get("messagesSent", 0))
            limit = int(item.get("dailyLimit", DAILY_LIMIT_DEFAULT))
            if item.get("windowDate") != _today():
              sent = 0
            return sent < limit
          def predict_step(s):
            allowed = [c for c in s.get("campaignSpec", {}).get("channels", ["email"]) if c in VALID_CHANNELS] or ["email"]
            assignments, excluded = [], []
            for c in s.get("customers", []):
              cid = c.get("customerId", "")
              chosen = next((ch for ch in [c.get("preferredChannel")] + allowed if ch in allowed and _available(ch, cid)), None)
              if chosen:
                assignments.append({"customerId": cid, "channel": chosen})
              else:
                excluded.append(cid)
            s["assignments"] = assignments
            s["excludedCustomerIds"] = excluded
            s["excludedCount"] = len(excluded)
            return s
          def safety_step(s):
            base = s.get("baseContent", {})
            subject, body = str(base.get("subject", "")), str(base.get("body", ""))
            findings, text = [], (subject + "\n" + body).lower()
            for term in BLOCKED_TERMS:
              if term in text:
                findings.append("blocked term: " + term)
            if _email.search(body):
              findings.append("contact email address in copy")
            if _phone.search(body):
              findings.append("phone number in copy")
            if len(body) > 1200:
              findings.append("copy exceeds 1200 characters")
            approved = not findings
            try:
              prompt = "Review this marketing copy for misleading claims, discriminatory language or policy violations. Brief: " + json.dumps(s.get("campaignSpec", {})) + " Subject: " + subject + " Body: " + body + ' Respond with JSON only: {"approved": true, "reasons": []}'
              review = _json(_invoke(None, prompt, 300))
              if isinstance(review, dict):
                if review.get("approved") is False:
                  approved = False
                findings.extend(str(r)[:120] for r in review.get("reasons", []) if r)
            except Exception as e:
              print("model safety review unavailable: %s" % e)
            s["safety"] = {"approved": bool(approved and not findings), "findings": findings[:10]}
            return s
          def adapt_step(s):
            spec, base = s.get("campaignSpec", {}), s.get("baseContent", {})
            cons = {"email": "Email: subject max 60 chars, body max 700 chars.", "sms": "SMS: max 160 chars, plain text.", "push": "Push: title max 40 chars, body max 120 chars."}
            def clip(t, n):
              return t if len(t) <= n else t[:n - 1].rstrip() + "..."
            def fb(ch):
              if ch == "sms":
                return {"text": clip(str(base.get("body", "")), 160)}
              if ch == "push":
                return {"title": clip(str(base.get("subject", "")), 40), "body": clip(str(base.get("body", "")), 120)}
              return {"subject": clip(str(base.get("subject", "")), 60), "body": clip(str(base.get("body", "")), 700)}
            content = {}
            for ch in sorted({a.get("channel") for a in s.get("assignments", []) if a.get("channel") in cons}):
              try:
                prompt = "Adapt this campaign copy for the " + ch + " channel. Constraints: " + cons[ch] + " Brief: " + json.dumps(spec) + " Base copy: " + json.dumps(base) + " Respond with JSON only."
                content[ch] = _json(_invoke(None, prompt, 500))
              except Exception as e:
                print("adaptation failed for %s: %s" % (ch, e))
                content[ch] = fb(ch)
            s["contentByChannel"] = content
            return s
          def _reserve(channel, customer_id):
            cur = _limits.get_item(Key={"channel": channel, "customerId": customer_id}).get("Item") or {}
            sent = int(cur.get("messagesSent", 0))
            limit = int(cur.get("dailyLimit", DAILY_LIMIT_DEFAULT))
            if cur.get("windowDate") != _today():
              sent = 0
            _limits.put_item(Item={"channel": channel, "customerId": customer_id, "messagesSent": sent + 1, "dailyLimit": limit, "windowDate": _today(), "expiresAt": int(time.time()) + 604800})
            return sent + 1
          def deliver_step(s):
            content = s.get("contentByChannel", {})
            profiles = {c.get("customerId"): c for c in s.get("customers", [])}
            deliveries = []
            for a in s.get("assignments", []):
              cid, ch = a.get("customerId"), a.get("channel")
              cust = profiles.get(cid, {})
              did = uuid.uuid4().hex
              status, detail = "FAILED", "no content generated for channel"
              try:
                m = content.get(ch)
                if ch == "email":
                  if cust.get("email") and m:
                    _ses.send_email(FromEmailAddress=NOTIFICATION_EMAIL, Destination={"ToAddresses": [cust["email"]]}, Content={"Simple": {"Subject": {"Data": str(m.get("subject", "")), "Charset": "UTF-8"}, "Body": {"Text": {"Data": str(m.get("body", "")), "Charset": "UTF-8"}}}})
                    status, detail = "SENT", "email accepted by SES"
                  else:
                    detail = "customer has no email address or no email content"
                elif ch == "sms":
                  if cust.get("phone") and m:
                    _sns.publish(PhoneNumber=cust["phone"], Message=str(m.get("text", ""))[:1600], MessageAttributes={"AWS.SNS.SMS.SenderID": {"DataType": "String", "StringValue": SMS_SENDER_ID}, "AWS.SNS.SMS.SMSType": {"DataType": "String", "StringValue": "Promotional"}})
                    status, detail = "SENT", "sms accepted by SNS using origination number " + SMS_ORIGINATION_NUMBER
                  else:
                    detail = "customer has no phone number or no sms content"
                elif ch == "push":
                  status, detail = "SIMULATED", "no push provider configured; delivery simulated"
              except Exception as e:
                status, detail = "FAILED", str(e)[:200]
              used = _reserve(ch, cid) if status in ("SENT", "FAILED") else 0
              _tracking.put_item(Item={"campaignId": s.get("campaignId"), "deliveryId": did, "customerId": cid, "channel": ch, "deliveryStatus": status, "detail": detail, "rateLimitUsed": used, "updatedAt": _iso(), "expiresAt": int(time.time()) + 7776000})
              deliveries.append({"deliveryId": did, "customerId": cid, "channel": ch, "status": status})
            s["deliveries"] = deliveries
            s["deliverySummary"] = {"total": len(deliveries), "sent": sum(1 for d in deliveries if d["status"] == "SENT"), "failed": sum(1 for d in deliveries if d["status"] == "FAILED"), "simulated": sum(1 for d in deliveries if d["status"] == "SIMULATED")}
            return s
          def record_step(s):
            cid = s.get("campaignId", "unknown")
            summ = s.get("deliverySummary", {"sent": 0, "failed": 0, "simulated": 0})
            status = "REJECTED" if not s.get("safety", {}).get("approved", True) else "COMPLETED"
            rec = {"campaignId": cid, "deliveryId": "summary", "campaignStatus": status, "objective": s.get("campaignSpec", {}).get("objective", ""), "audience": s.get("campaignSpec", {}).get("audience", ""), "customerCount": s.get("customerCount", 0), "deliveredCount": summ.get("sent", 0) + summ.get("simulated", 0), "failedCount": summ.get("failed", 0), "safetyFindings": s.get("safety", {}).get("findings", []), "updatedAt": _iso()}
            _tracking.put_item(Item=rec)
            try:
              _s3.put_object(Bucket=RESULTS_BUCKET, Key="campaigns/%s/results.json" % cid, Body=json.dumps(s, default=str).encode("utf-8"), ContentType="application/json")
            except Exception as e:
              print("could not archive campaign results: %s" % e)
            s["campaignResult"] = {"status": status, "customerCount": rec["customerCount"], "deliveredCount": rec["deliveredCount"], "failedCount": rec["failedCount"], "resultsKey": "campaigns/%s/results.json" % cid}
            return s
          STEPS = {"parse": parse_step, "segment": segment_step, "predict": predict_step, "safety": safety_step, "adapt": adapt_step, "deliver": deliver_step, "record": record_step}
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
            handler = STEPS.get(str(event.get("step", "")))
            if not handler:
              raise ValueError("unknown step")
            return handler(event.get("state") or {})

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import datetime, json, os, uuid
          import boto3
          TRACKING_TABLE = os.environ["TRACKING_TABLE"]
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN = os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"]
          CALLBACK_TOKEN = os.environ["CALLBACK_TOKEN"]
          ALLOWED_STATUSES = ("DELIVERED", "SENT", "FAILED", "BOUNCED", "QUEUED")
          _ddb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          _low = boto3.client("dynamodb")
          _sfn = boto3.client("stepfunctions")
          _tracking = _ddb.Table(TRACKING_TABLE)
          def _r(status, payload):
            return {"statusCode": status, "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, "body": json.dumps(payload)}
          def _now():
            return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
          def _launch(body):
            instruction = str(body.get("instruction", "")).strip()
            if not instruction:
              return _r(400, {"message": "instruction is required"})
            if len(instruction) > 4000:
              return _r(413, {"message": "instruction exceeds 4000 characters"})
            cid = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
            ex = _sfn.start_execution(StateMachineArn=STATE_MACHINE_ARN, Name="campaign-" + cid, Input=json.dumps({"campaignId": cid, "instruction": instruction}))
            _tracking.put_item(Item={"campaignId": cid, "deliveryId": "summary", "campaignStatus": "SUBMITTED", "instruction": instruction[:200], "executionArn": ex["executionArn"], "updatedAt": _now()})
            return _r(202, {"campaignId": cid, "executionArn": ex["executionArn"], "status": "SUBMITTED"})
          def _status(campaign_id):
            if not campaign_id:
              return _r(400, {"message": "campaignId path parameter is required"})
            c = _tracking.get_item(Key={"campaignId": campaign_id, "deliveryId": "summary"}).get("Item")
            if not c:
              return _r(404, {"message": "campaign not found"})
            body = {"campaignId": campaign_id, "status": c.get("campaignStatus", "UNKNOWN"), "updatedAt": str(c.get("updatedAt", "")), "deliveredCount": int(c.get("deliveredCount", 0)), "failedCount": int(c.get("failedCount", 0))}
            earn = c.get("executionArn")
            if earn:
              try:
                body["executionStatus"] = _sfn.describe_execution(executionArn=earn)["status"]
              except Exception as e:
                print("describe_execution failed: %s" % e)
            return _r(200, body)
          def _callback(event, body):
            if CALLBACK_TOKEN and (event.get("headers") or {}).get("x-callback-token") != CALLBACK_TOKEN:
              return _r(403, {"message": "invalid callback token"})
            cid, did = body.get("campaignId"), body.get("deliveryId")
            status = str(body.get("status", "")).upper()
            if not cid or not did or status not in ALLOWED_STATUSES:
              return _r(400, {"message": "campaignId, deliveryId and valid status are required"})
            try:
              _low.update_item(TableName=TRACKING_TABLE, Key={"campaignId": {"S": cid}, "deliveryId": {"S": did}}, UpdateExpression="SET deliveryStatus = :s, detail = :d, updatedAt = :u", ConditionExpression="attribute_exists(deliveryId)", ExpressionAttributeValues={":s": {"S": status}, ":d": {"S": str(body.get("reason", "provider delivery callback"))[:200]}, ":u": {"S": _now()}})
            except _low.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException:
              return _r(404, {"message": "delivery record not found"})
            return _r(200, {"campaignId": cid, "deliveryId": did, "deliveryStatus": status})
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
            raw = event.get("body")
            try:
              body = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else (raw or {})
            except ValueError:
              return _r(400, {"message": "request body must be JSON"})
            route = event.get("routeKey", "")
            if route == "POST /campaigns":
              return _launch(body)
            if route == "GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/status":
              return _status((event.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("campaignId", ""))
            if route == "POST /callbacks/delivery":
              return _callback(event, body)
            return _r(404, {"message": "not found"})

    Properties:

      Runtime: python3.12

      Handler: index.lambda_handler

      Timeout: 60

      Role: !GetAtt SemanticSearchFunctionRole.Arn

        Variables:
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable

          COLLECTION_ENDPOINT: !GetAtt SemanticSearchCollection.CollectionEndpoint
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, urllib.error, urllib.request
          import boto3
          from botocore.auth import SigV4Auth
          from botocore.awsrequest import AWSRequest
          COLLECTION_ENDPOINT = os.environ["COLLECTION_ENDPOINT"]
          PROFILES_TABLE = os.environ["PROFILES_TABLE"]
          EMBED_MODEL_ID = os.environ["EMBED_MODEL_ID"]
          INDEX_NAME = os.environ.get("VECTOR_INDEX_NAME", "campaign-profiles")
          _session = boto3.session.Session()
          _bedrock = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          def _resp(status, payload):
            return {"statusCode": status, "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, "body": json.dumps(payload)}
          def _embed(text):
            response = _bedrock.invoke_model(modelId=EMBED_MODEL_ID, body=json.dumps({"inputText": text}))
            return json.loads(response["body"].read())["embedding"]
          def _request(method, path, body=None):
            url = COLLECTION_ENDPOINT.rstrip("/") + path
            request = AWSRequest(method=method, url=url, data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8") if body is not None else None, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
            SigV4Auth(_session.get_credentials(), "aoss", _session.region_name).add_auth(request)
            prepared = request.prepare()
            req = urllib.request.Request(prepared.url, data=prepared.body, headers=dict(prepared.headers), method=method)
            try:
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                raw = response.read()
                return response.status, (json.loads(raw) if raw else {})
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
              raw = error.read()
              return error.code, (json.loads(raw) if raw else {})
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
            if isinstance(event.get("body"), str):
              try:
                payload = json.loads(event["body"])
              except ValueError:
                return _resp(400, {"message": "request body must be JSON"})
            else:
              payload = event.get("body") or event
            mode = payload.get("mode", "search")
            if mode == "index":
              table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(PROFILES_TABLE)
              indexed = 0
              for profile in table.scan(Limit=50).get("Items", []):
                text = " ".join(str(profile.get(k, "")) for k in ("displayName", "segment", "region", "tier", "interests", "notes"))
                _request("PUT", "/%s/_doc/%s" % (INDEX_NAME, profile.get("customerId", "unknown")), {"customerId": profile.get("customerId", "unknown"), "text": text, "vector": _embed(text)})
                indexed += 1
              return _resp(200, {"mode": "index", "indexed": indexed})
            query = str(payload.get("query", "")).strip()
            if not query:
              return _resp(400, {"message": "query is required"})
            try:
              size = max(1, min(int(payload.get("maxResults", 5)), 20))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
              size = 5
            status, results = _request("POST", "/%s/_search" % INDEX_NAME, {"size": size, "query": {"knn": {"vector": {"vector": _embed(query), "k": size}}}, "_source": ["customerId", "text"]})
            if status >= 300:
              return _resp(502, {"message": "vector search request failed", "detail": results})
            hits = [dict(hit.get("_source", {}), score=hit.get("_score")) for hit in results.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])]
            return _resp(200, {"mode": "search", "query": query, "results": hits})

      IdTokenValidity: 60

    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer

      AuthorizerType: JWT

      JwtConfiguration:
        Audience: [!Ref CampaignUserPoolClient]
        Issuer: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${CampaignUserPool}'

  RouterIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY

      PayloadFormatVersion: "2.0"
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  LauncherRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'POST /campaigns'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${RouterIntegration}'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CampaignApiAuthorizer

  StatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'GET /campaigns/{campaignId}/status'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${RouterIntegration}'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CampaignApiAuthorizer

  CallbackRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'POST /callbacks/delivery'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${RouterIntegration}'
      AuthorizationType: NONE

  LaunchInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiRouterFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*/POST/campaigns'

  StatusInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiRouterFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*/GET/campaigns/*/status'

  CallbackInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ApiRouterFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*/POST/callbacks/delivery'

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${CampaignHttpApi}/*/POST/search'

  SearchRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Condition: CreateSemanticSearch
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      RouteKey: 'POST /search'
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${SearchIntegration}'
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CampaignApiAuthorizer

  SearchIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Condition: CreateSemanticSearch
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${SemanticSearchFunction.Arn}/invocations'
      PayloadFormatVersion: "2.0"
      TimeoutInMillis: 29000

  CampaignApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref CampaignHttpApi
      StageName: "$default"
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt HttpApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status"}'
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 50
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 100

  CampaignOrchestrator:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-campaign-orchestrator'
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup: {LogGroupArn: !GetAtt OrchestrationLogGroup.Arn}
      TracingConfiguration: {Enabled: true}
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {"StartAt": "Parse", "TimeoutSeconds": 300, "States": {
        "Parse": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "parse", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "Next": "Segment"},
        "Segment": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "segment", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "Next": "Predict"},
        "Predict": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "predict", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "Next": "Safety"},
        "Safety": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "safety", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "Next": "Approved"},
        "Approved": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.safety.approved", "BooleanEquals": true, "Next": "Adapt"}], "Default": "Record"},
        "Adapt": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "adapt", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "Next": "Deliver"},
        "Deliver": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "deliver", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "Next": "Record"},
        "Record": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Parameters": {"FunctionName": "${PipelineFunction}", "Payload": {"step": "record", "state.$": "$"}}, "Retry": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.TaskFailed"], "IntervalSeconds": 2, "BackoffRate": 2.0, "MaxAttempts": 3}], "End": true}}}

    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: CreateSemanticSearch
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SemanticSearchCollectionName}-encryption'
      Type: encryption
      Policy: !Sub |
        {"Rules": [{"ResourceType": "collection", "Resource": ["collection/${SemanticSearchCollectionName}"]}], "AWSOwnedKey": false, "KmsKeyArn": "${CampaignDataKey.Arn}"}

  SemanticSearchNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: CreateSemanticSearch
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SemanticSearchCollectionName}-network'
      Type: network

        [{"Rules": [{"ResourceType": "collection", "Resource": ["collection/${SemanticSearchCollectionName}"], "AllowVendedDataAccess": true, "AllowFromPublic": true}, {"ResourceType": "dashboard", "Resource": ["dashboard/${SemanticSearchCollectionName}"], "AllowFromPublic": true}], "AllowFromPublic": true}]

  SemanticSearchDataAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: CreateSemanticSearch
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${SemanticSearchCollectionName}-data-access'

        [{"Rules": [{"ResourceType": "index", "Resource": ["index/${SemanticSearchCollectionName}/*"], "Permission": ["aoss:CreateIndex", "aoss:UpdateIndex", "aoss:DescribeIndex", "aoss:ReadDocument", "aoss:WriteDocument", "aoss:DeleteIndex"]}, {"ResourceType": "collection", "Resource": ["collection/${SemanticSearchCollectionName}"], "Permission": ["aoss:CreateCollectionItems", "aoss:UpdateCollectionItems", "aoss:DescribeCollectionItems"]}], "Principal": ["${SemanticSearchFunctionRole.Arn}", "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"]}]

      OKActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
